Model 12:39 AMYes, you can do this, and you don’t need messy browser extensions or cloud subscriptions to make it work.

The two best ways to turn your Pixel 7 with modded Gboard into a live dictation feed for your Mac are:

### Method 1: The Bluetooth Hardware Hack (Zero Setup on Mac)

The cleanest, lowest-latency method is making your Mac think your Pixel 7 is literally an external Bluetooth keyboard.

When your phone acts as a Bluetooth Human Interface Device (HID), anything you dictate into your phone gets fired as raw hardware keystrokes directly into whatever window is focused on your Mac—whether it’s a Chrome tab, VS Code, or a text prompt.

1. **Install an HID app on your Pixel**:Download an app like **Serverless Bluetooth Keyboard & Mouse** (available on Google Play / F-Droid).**Pair with your Mac**:Turn on Bluetooth on your Mac and pair with your Pixel inside the app. Your Mac will register your phone as a standard external keyboard.**Dictate**:Inside the app, tap the text input box so your modded Gboard pops up. Hit your voice/Rambler button, and talk.As Gboard transcribes, the app streams the text over Bluetooth straight to your Mac’s blinking cursor.
**Why this is great:**
* Nothing to install or run on your Mac.Works across the entire OS (not just Chrome).Works with no Wi-Fi or internet connection between the two devices.

### Method 2: A 30-Line Local Python Bridge (Custom & Instant)

If you don't want to use Bluetooth or want instant text block dumping (inserting whole paragraphs without waiting for individual key events), you can run a tiny local HTTP server on your Mac.

#### How it works:

1. You run a tiny Python script on your Mac.You open a bookmark on your phone's browser (http://your-mac-ip:5000).It has a single clean text area. You tap it, speak as long as you want with Gboard/Rambler, and tap "Send" (or auto-send on silence).The Mac instantly pastes the text directly into whatever text box you currently have clicked on.
Here is the exact script if you want to run this locally:

```
# server.py (Run on your Mac: pip install flask pyautogui)
from flask import Flask, request, render_template_string
import pyautogui
import pyperclip

app = Flask(__name__)

HTML = """
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; background: #121212; color: #fff; font-family: sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; }
        textarea { flex: 1; width: 100%; background: #1e1e1e; color: #fff; font-size: 18px; border: none; padding: 16px; box-sizing: border-box; }
        button { height: 70px; background: #0088ff; color: #fff; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; border: none; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <textarea id="box" placeholder="Tap voice mic and speak..."></textarea>
    <button onclick="send()">SEND TO MAC</button>
    <script>
        function send() {
            const val = document.getElementById('box').value;
            if (!val) return;
            fetch('/type', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({text: val})
            }).then(() => {
                document.getElementById('box').value = '';
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
"""

@app.route('/')
def index():
    return render_template_string(HTML)

@app.route('/type', methods=['POST'])
def type_text():
    text = request.json.get('text', '')
    if text:
        # Copies to Mac clipboard and executes Cmd+V into your active window
        pyperclip.copy(text)
        pyautogui.hotkey('command', 'v')
    return ('', 204)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=5000)
```

Run python3 server.py, check your Mac's local IP (e.g. 192.168.1.15:5000), open that on your Pixel, and you have your own dedicated dictation terminal.

### Which one should you use?

* If you want **streaming live words as you talk**, use **Method 1 (Bluetooth HID)**.If you tend to speak in **dense paragraphs and want the whole chunk pasted instantly**, use **Method 2 (Python Bridge)**.

Model 12:45 AMThe reason the Bluetooth app feels like a typewriter is because of how Bluetooth HID works: it is literally simulating a human finger pressing and releasing every single letter, space, and punctuation mark one packet at a time. For a short sentence it’s fine, but for a 200-word paragraph it has to send thousands of individual hardware packets.

If you want **instantaneous** injection—where a 500-word wall of text lands in your Chrome box in literally one millisecond—you have to use **Clipboard Injection** (pbcopy + Cmd+V).

Here is a **zero-dependency** version of that Mac bridge. It uses only Python's built-in standard library (no pip install, no third-party libraries) and native macOS commands (pbcopy and AppleScript).

### Step 1: Create the script on your Mac

Save this as dictate.py on your Mac:

```
import subprocess
from http.server import HTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler
import json

HTML = """<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=1">
    <title>Voice Bridge</title>
    <style>
        * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
        body { background: #080c10; color: #fff; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; height: 100vh; }
        textarea { flex: 1; width: 100%; background: #0f1620; color: #fff; font-size: 19px; border: none; padding: 20px; outline: none; resize: none; line-height: 1.5; }
        #btn { height: 80px; background: #0077ff; color: #fff; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; border: none; cursor: pointer; }
        #btn:active { background: #0055cc; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <textarea id="box" placeholder="Tap mic on Gboard, dictate, then tap send..."></textarea>
    <button id="btn" onclick="send()">INSTANT SEND TO MAC</button>
    <script>
        function send() {
            const box = document.getElementById('box');
            const text = box.value;
            if (!text.trim()) return;
            
            fetch('/paste', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({text: text})
            }).then(() => {
                box.value = '';
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
"""

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(HTML.encode('utf-8'))

    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path == '/paste':
            length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
            body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8'))
            text = body.get('text', '')

            if text:
                # 1. Instantly copy entire text block to macOS clipboard
                p = subprocess.Popen(['pbcopy'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
                p.communicate(text.encode('utf-8'))

                # 2. Fire native macOS Cmd+V into the currently focused window
                apple_script = 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "v" using command down'
                subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', apple_script])

            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        return  # Keep terminal clean

if __name__ == '__main__':
    port = 5050
    print(f"Server live. Open on your phone: http://<your-mac-ip>:{port}")
    HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', port), Handler).serve_forever()
```

### Step 2: Grant macOS Permissions (First time only)

Because macOS protects keystroke automation, you need to grant Terminal (or whatever app runs the script) permission to simulate keys:
1. Go to **System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility**.Make sure **Terminal** (or iTerm / VS Code) is toggled **ON**.

### Step 3: Run it

1. In your Mac Terminal, run:

```
python3 dictate.py
```

Find your Mac’s local Wi-Fi IP (Option-click the Wi-Fi icon in your menu bar to see it, e.g. 192.168.1.45).On your Pixel 7, open Chrome and bookmark:

```
http://192.168.1.45:5050
```

Keep your text cursor clicked inside your PC's browser tab.

Pick up your phone, dictate as long as you want with your modded Gboard/Rambler, and hit the big blue button. Whether it’s two words or a five-page essay, the entire block appears on your Mac **instantly**. Zero typing delay.

    def do_GET(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8')
        self.end_headers()

            self.send_response(204)

if __name__ == '__main__':

Model 2:35 AMRight now, yes—if you close that Terminal window, the server stops.

You don't have to keep doing that, though. On a Mac, you can turn this into a silent background service that starts automatically every time you log in. It uses basically 0% CPU and takes about 10MB of RAM, so you never have to touch Terminal again.

Here is how to make it run completely silently in the background:

### The 1-Minute Setup

Paste this into your Terminal (all one block) and press **Enter**:

```
mkdir -p ~/Library/LaunchAgents

cat << 'EOF' > ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.dictate.plist
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
    <key>Label</key>
    <string>com.user.dictate</string>
    <key>ProgramArguments</key>
    <array>
        <string>/usr/bin/python3</string>
        <string>/Users/ethanfreeman/Downloads/AI Studio apps/Dictate/dictate.py</string>
    </array>
    <key>RunAtLoad</key>
    <true/>
    <key>KeepAlive</key>
    <true/>
</dict>
</plist>
EOF

launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.dictate.plist
```

### What happens now:

* It starts immediately in the background.It will automatically launch every time your MacBook turns on.You can close Terminal completely. It doesn't need to be open.Your bookmark on your Pixel 7 will just always work whenever you're on your home Wi-Fi.
(If you ever want to stop or uninstall it later, you just run: launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.dictate.plist)

### One common trap to watch out for:

If you still had the **first** python3 dictate.py command running in your Terminal window when you loaded the service, port 5050 was already blocked, so the background service couldn't grab the port.

```

launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.dictate.plist
```

Model 2:52 AMLet's make **VoiceBridge** a proper dedicated tool.

For a phone-to-desktop dictation bridge, the mobile UI needs to be friction-free:
* **Instant focus**: The text box focuses automatically when you open the bookmark so Gboard pops up immediately without extra tapping.**Haptic feedback**: A subtle phone vibration when you tap Send so your thumb knows the Mac received it.**Visual receipt**: The button pulses green and says "SENT!" so you don't have to look up at your laptop screen to verify it landed.**Word & character counter**: Handy for pacing prompts or long emails.**Permanent background install**: Moving it out of Downloads into ~/Library/Application Support/VoiceBridge/ so macOS allows it to run silently in the background on boot without needing Terminal open.

### Install the Polished VoiceBridge & Background Service

In your Mac Terminal, press **Ctrl + C** to stop the temporary process, then copy and paste this entire block and hit **Enter**:

```

mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/Application Support/VoiceBridge"

# 2. Write the polished VoiceBridge script

    <header>
        <div class="brand">

            VoiceBridge
        </div>

    </header>

        <textarea id="input" placeholder="Tap mic on Gboard to dictate..." autofocus></textarea>
    </main>

        <button id="clear-btn" onclick="clearText()">CLEAR</button>

    <script>
        const input = document.getElementById('input');
        const counter = document.getElementById('counter');
        const sendBtn = document.getElementById('send-btn');

        input.addEventListener('input', updateCount);

        function updateCount() {
            const val = input.value.trim();
            const chars = input.value.length;

            input.value = '';
            updateCount();
            input.focus();

        function sendText() {

            if (!text.trim()) return;

            sendBtn.classList.add('success');
            sendBtn.innerText = 'SENT!';

            fetch('/paste', {
                method: 'POST',

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(HTML.encode('utf-8'))

    def do_POST(self):

            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        return

if __name__ == '__main__':
    port = 5050
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)

    finally:

Here is the exact reason:

A symlink does not trick macOS security. When launchd tried to run ~/.voicebridge/voicebridge.py, macOS followed the link straight back to the **Downloads** folder, hit the security wall, and blocked it.

```

rm -f "$HOME/Downloads/Ai Studio Apps/VoiceBridge/voicebridge.py"
ln -s "$HOME/.voicebridge/voicebridge.py" "$HOME/Downloads/Ai Studio Apps/VoiceBridge/voicebridge.py"

# 4. Reload the service
launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.voicebridge.plist

# 5. Check status

            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            height: 100vh;
            height: 100dvh;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 14px 20px;
            background: var(--panel);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .brand {
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: 800;

            color: #fff;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 8px;
        }
        .status-dot {
            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: #00ffaa;
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px #00ffaa;
        }
        .meta {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-family: monospace;
            color: var(--text-dim);
        }
        main {
            flex: 1;

        }
        textarea {
            flex: 1;
            width: 100%;
            background: var(--panel);
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 12px;
            color: #f0f4f8;
            font-size: 19px;
            line-height: 1.5;
            padding: 18px;

            resize: none;

            border-color: rgba(0, 136, 255, 0.4);

            font-size: 17px;
        }

            gap: 10px;
            padding: 0 16px 16px 16px;

        button {
            border: none;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.15s ease;
            font-family: inherit;
        }
        #clear-btn {
            width: 70px;
            background: var(--panel);

        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <header>
        <div class="brand">
            <div class="status-dot"></div>
            VoiceBridge
        </div>
        <div class="meta" id="counter">0 words &bull; 0 chars</div>
    </header>

    <main>
        <textarea id="input" placeholder="Tap mic on Gboard to dictate..." autofocus></textarea>
    </main>

    <footer>
        <button id="clear-btn" onclick="clearText()">CLEAR</button>
        <button id="send-btn" onclick="sendText()">SEND TO MAC</button>
    </footer>

    <script>
        const input = document.getElementById('input');
        const counter = document.getElementById('counter');
        const sendBtn = document.getElementById('send-btn');

        input.addEventListener('input', updateCount);

        function updateCount() {
            const val = input.value.trim();
            const chars = input.value.length;
            const words = val ? val.split(/\s+/).length : 0;
            counter.innerHTML = `${words} words &bull; ${chars} chars`;
        }

        function clearText() {
            input.value = '';
            updateCount();
            input.focus();
        }

        function sendText() {
            const text = input.value;
            if (!text.trim()) return;

            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(30);

            sendBtn.classList.add('success');
            sendBtn.innerText = 'SENT!';

            fetch('/paste', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({text: text})
            }).then(() => {
                input.value = '';
                updateCount();
                setTimeout(() => {
                    sendBtn.classList.remove('success');
                    sendBtn.innerText = 'SEND TO MAC';
                    input.focus();
                }, 700);
            }).catch(() => {
                sendBtn.classList.remove('success');
                sendBtn.innerText = 'FAILED TO REACH MAC';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    sendBtn.innerText = 'SEND TO MAC';
                }, 1500);
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
"""

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(HTML.encode('utf-8'))

    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path == '/paste':
            length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
            body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8'))
            text = body.get('text', '')

            if text:
                p = subprocess.Popen(['pbcopy'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
                p.communicate(text.encode('utf-8'))

                apple_script = 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "v" using command down'
                subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', apple_script])

            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        return

if __name__ == '__main__':
    port = 5050
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    try:
        s.connect(('8.8.8.8', 80))
        local_ip = s.getsockname()[0]
    except Exception:
        local_ip = 'localhost'
    finally:
        s.close()

    print(f"VoiceBridge Daemon live at: http://{local_ip}:{port}")
    HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', port), Handler).serve_forever()

Model 3:09 AMTo make VoiceBridge feel like a high-end native tool rather than a basic text box, we can add a handful of lightweight features that eliminate extra taps:

### Smart Features to Add

1. **"Auto-Enter" Toggle (Send + Submit)**:When active, VoiceBridge pastes the text and immediately presses Enter on your Mac. If you're dictating into ChatGPT, Claude, or a search bar, you don't even have to touch your laptop keyboard to submit the prompt.**Mac "Undo" Button (Cmd+Z)**:If you accidentally paste into the wrong tab or want to retract what you just sent, tapping "Undo" on your phone fires Cmd+Z on your Mac.**Synthesized Audio Blip (WebAudio)**:A clean, synthesized high-tech audio chime on your phone when a transmission succeeds. You don't have to look up at your laptop screen to know it landed.**Recent History Drawer**:A collapsible tray storing your last 5 voice snippets in your phone’s local storage. If you lose a tab or want to re-send a prompt, you can tap it to restore it instantly.**Text Formatting Bar**:Thumb-friendly chips right above the keyboard for things voice dictation often messes up: New Line, Code Block ("""), Quotes, and Tab.

</head>
<body>
    <header>
        <div class="brand">
            <div class="status-dot"></div>
            VoiceBridge
        </div>
        <div class="header-actions">
            <div class="tag-counter" id="counter">0w &bull; 0c</div>
            <button class="chip" onclick="toggleHistory(true)">HISTORY</button>
        </div>
    </header>

    <main>
        <div class="textarea-wrapper">
            <textarea id="input" placeholder="Tap mic on Gboard to dictate..." autofocus></textarea>
        </div>

        <div class="util-bar">
            <button class="chip toggle active" id="btn-auto-enter" onclick="toggleAutoEnter()">+ ENTER ON MAC</button>
            <button class="chip" onclick="insertText('\\n')">+ LINE</button>
            <button class="chip" onclick="insertText('\\"\\"\\"')">+ CODE BLOCK</button>
            <button class="chip" onclick="triggerMacUndo()">MAC UNDO</button>
        </div>
    </main>

    <footer>
        <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="clearText()">CLEAR</button>
        <button id="send-btn" onclick="sendText()">SEND TO MAC</button>
    </footer>

    <!-- History Drawer -->
    <div id="history-sheet">
        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
            <div style="font-weight:800; letter-spacing:1.5px;">RECENT DICTATIONS</div>
            <button class="chip" onclick="toggleHistory(false)">CLOSE</button>
        </div>
        <div class="history-list" id="history-items"></div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const input = document.getElementById('input');
        const counter = document.getElementById('counter');
        const sendBtn = document.getElementById('send-btn');
        let autoEnter = true;

        // Sound Synthesis (WebAudio blips - zero external audio assets)
        const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        function playChime(freq = 600, duration = 0.08) {
            try {
                if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
                const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
                osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 1.5, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, audioCtx.currentTime);
                gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                osc.start();
                osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        input.addEventListener('input', updateCount);

        function updateCount() {
            const val = input.value.trim();
            const chars = input.value.length;
            const words = val ? val.split(/\\s+/).length : 0;
            counter.innerHTML = `${words}w &bull; ${chars}c`;
        }

        function clearText() {
            input.value = '';
            updateCount();
            input.focus();
        }

        function insertText(str) {
            const start = input.selectionStart;
            const end = input.selectionEnd;
            input.value = input.value.substring(0, start) + str + input.value.substring(end);
            input.selectionStart = input.selectionEnd = start + str.length;
            updateCount();
            input.focus();
        }

        function toggleAutoEnter() {
            autoEnter = !autoEnter;
            document.getElementById('btn-auto-enter').classList.toggle('active', autoEnter);
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(20);
        }

        function saveToHistory(text) {
            let history = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('vb_history') || '[]');
            history.unshift(text);
            if (history.length > 8) history.pop();
            localStorage.setItem('vb_history', JSON.stringify(history));
        }

        function toggleHistory(open) {
            const sheet = document.getElementById('history-sheet');
            sheet.classList.toggle('open', open);
            if (open) {
                const list = document.getElementById('history-items');
                const history = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('vb_history') || '[]');
                if (history.length === 0) {
                    list.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--text-dim); text-align:center; margin-top:40px;">No history yet.</div>';
                    return;
                }
                list.innerHTML = history.map(item => `
                    <div class="history-item" onclick="loadHistoryItem(\`${encodeURIComponent(item)}\`)">
                        ${item.length > 120 ? item.substring(0, 120) + '...' : item}
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            }
        }

        function loadHistoryItem(encoded) {
            input.value = decodeURIComponent(encoded);
            updateCount();
            toggleHistory(false);
            input.focus();
        }

        function triggerMacUndo() {
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(25);
            fetch('/undo', { method: 'POST' });
        }

        function sendText() {
            const text = input.value;
            if (!text.trim()) return;

            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(35);
            playChime(550);

            sendBtn.classList.add('success');
            sendBtn.innerText = 'SENT!';

            fetch('/paste', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    text: text,
                    autoEnter: autoEnter
                })
            }).then(() => {
                saveToHistory(text);
                input.value = '';
                updateCount();
                setTimeout(() => {
                    sendBtn.classList.remove('success');
                    sendBtn.innerText = 'SEND TO MAC';
                    input.focus();
                }, 600);
            }).catch(() => {
                sendBtn.classList.remove('success');
                sendBtn.innerText = 'FAILED TO REACH MAC';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    sendBtn.innerText = 'SEND TO MAC';
                }, 1500);
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
"""

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(HTML.encode('utf-8'))

    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path == '/paste':
            length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
            body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8'))
            text = body.get('text', '')
            auto_enter = body.get('autoEnter', False)

            if text:
                # Copy entire text chunk directly into macOS clipboard
                p = subprocess.Popen(['pbcopy'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
                p.communicate(text.encode('utf-8'))

                # Paste, then press Enter if autoEnter is on
                script = 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "v" using command down'
                if auto_enter:
                    script += '\ntell application "System Events" to key code 36'
                subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', script])

            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()

        elif self.path == '/undo':
            # Sends Cmd+Z directly to macOS
            script = 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "z" using command down'
            subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', script])
            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        return

if __name__ == '__main__':
    port = 5050
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    try:
        s.connect(('8.8.8.8', 80))
        local_ip = s.getsockname()[0]
    except Exception:
        local_ip = 'localhost'
    finally:
        s.close()

    print(f"VoiceBridge live: http://{local_ip}:{port}")
    HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', port), Handler).serve_forever()
```

            </div>

                <button class="chip" onclick="insertText('\\n')">+ LINE</button>
                <button class="chip" onclick="insertText('\\"\\"\\"')">+ CODE BLOCK</button>
                <button class="chip" onclick="triggerMacUndo()">MAC UNDO</button>
            </div>
        </main>

        <footer>
            <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="clearText()">CLEAR</button>
            <button id="send-btn" onclick="sendText()">SEND TO MAC</button>
        </footer>
    </div>

    <!-- History Drawer -->
    <div id="history-sheet">
        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
            <div style="font-weight:800; letter-spacing:1.5px;">RECENT DICTATIONS</div>
            <button class="chip" onclick="toggleHistory(false)">CLOSE</button>
        </div>
        <div class="history-list" id="history-items"></div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const root = document.getElementById('app-root');
        const input = document.getElementById('input');
        const counter = document.getElementById('counter');
        const sendBtn = document.getElementById('send-btn');
        let autoEnter = true;

        // Dynamic Keyboard Docking via VisualViewport
        function updateViewportHeight() {
            if (window.visualViewport) {
                root.style.height = window.visualViewport.height + 'px';
            }
        }
        if (window.visualViewport) {
            window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', updateViewportHeight);
            window.visualViewport.addEventListener('scroll', updateViewportHeight);
            updateViewportHeight();
        }

        // Auto Device Theme Sync
        const colorSchemeQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
        function handleThemeChange(e) {
            const metaTheme = document.getElementById('meta-theme-color');
            if (metaTheme) {
                metaTheme.setAttribute('content', e.matches ? '#070a0e' : '#f8fafc');
            }
        }
        colorSchemeQuery.addEventListener('change', handleThemeChange);
        handleThemeChange(colorSchemeQuery);

        // Sound Synthesis
        const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        function playChime(freq = 600, duration = 0.08) {
            try {
                if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
                const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
                osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 1.5, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.15, audioCtx.currentTime);
                gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                osc.start();
                osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        input.addEventListener('input', updateCount);

        function updateCount() {
            const val = input.value.trim();
            const chars = input.value.length;
            const words = val ? val.split(/\\s+/).length : 0;
            counter.innerHTML = `${words}w &bull; ${chars}c`;
        }

        function clearText() {
            input.value = '';
            updateCount();
            input.focus();
        }

        function insertText(str) {
            const start = input.selectionStart;
            const end = input.selectionEnd;
            input.value = input.value.substring(0, start) + str + input.value.substring(end);
            input.selectionStart = input.selectionEnd = start + str.length;
            updateCount();
            input.focus();
        }

        function toggleAutoEnter() {
            autoEnter = !autoEnter;
            document.getElementById('btn-auto-enter').classList.toggle('active', autoEnter);
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(20);
        }

        function saveToHistory(text) {
            let history = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('vb_history') || '[]');
            history.unshift(text);
            if (history.length > 8) history.pop();
            localStorage.setItem('vb_history', JSON.stringify(history));
        }

        function toggleHistory(open) {
            const sheet = document.getElementById('history-sheet');
            sheet.classList.toggle('open', open);
            if (open) {
                const list = document.getElementById('history-items');
                const history = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('vb_history') || '[]');
                if (history.length === 0) {
                    list.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--text-dim); text-align:center; margin-top:40px;">No history yet.</div>';
                    return;
                }
                list.innerHTML = history.map(item => `
                    <div class="history-item" onclick="loadHistoryItem(\`${encodeURIComponent(item)}\`)">
                        ${item.length > 120 ? item.substring(0, 120) + '...' : item}
                    </div>
                `).join('');
            }
        }

        function loadHistoryItem(encoded) {
            input.value = decodeURIComponent(encoded);
            updateCount();
            toggleHistory(false);
            input.focus();
        }

        function triggerMacUndo() {
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(25);
            fetch('/undo', { method: 'POST' });
        }

        function sendText() {
            const text = input.value;
            if (!text.trim()) return;

            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(35);
            playChime(550);

            sendBtn.classList.add('success');
            sendBtn.innerText = 'SENT!';

            fetch('/paste', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({
                    text: text,
                    autoEnter: autoEnter
                })
            }).then(() => {
                saveToHistory(text);
                input.value = '';
                updateCount();
                setTimeout(() => {
                    sendBtn.classList.remove('success');
                    sendBtn.innerText = 'SEND TO MAC';
                    input.focus();
                }, 500);
            }).catch(() => {
                sendBtn.classList.remove('success');
                sendBtn.innerText = 'FAILED TO REACH MAC';
                setTimeout(() => {
                    sendBtn.innerText = 'SEND TO MAC';
                }, 1500);
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
"""

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(HTML.encode('utf-8'))

    def do_POST(self):
        if self.path == '/paste':
            length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
            body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8'))
            text = body.get('text', '')
            auto_enter = body.get('autoEnter', False)

            if text:
                p = subprocess.Popen(['pbcopy'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
                p.communicate(text.encode('utf-8'))

                script = 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "v" using command down'
                if auto_enter:
                    script += '\ntell application "System Events" to key code 36'
                subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', script])

            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()

        elif self.path == '/undo':
            script = 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "z" using command down'
            subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', script])
            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        return

if __name__ == '__main__':
    port = 5050
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    try:
        s.connect(('8.8.8.8', 80))
        local_ip = s.getsockname()[0]
    except Exception:
        local_ip = 'localhost'
    finally:
        s.close()

    print(f"VoiceBridge live: http://{local_ip}:{port}")
    HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', port), Handler).serve_forever()

Model 3:29 AMHere is what is happening under the hood, and how we fix both:

### Why pull-to-refresh stopped working

In the last update, html, body { overflow: hidden; } and user-select: none were set to keep the keyboard from bouncing the screen. Modern mobile browsers (Brave/Chrome on Android) see that and completely disable the native pull-down refresh gesture.

We can re-enable natural overscroll **and** add a dedicated ⟳ reload button right in the top header so you can refresh with one tap without dragging.

### The Mac vs. Phone Experience & Two-Way Sync

You're completely right: when you opened localhost:5050 on the Mac, it was a mirror of the phone UI. When you clicked "Send to Mac", it copied the text to your clipboard, simulated Cmd+V, and cleared the box—pasting the text right back into itself!

Instead of a one-way dump, VoiceBridge can be a **two-way wireless clipboard and dictation hub**:
1. **Automatic Device Awareness**:**On your Pixel**: The primary button is **PASTE AT MAC CURSOR** (instantly injects text into whatever app is active on your Mac with your modded Gboard).**On your Mac**: VoiceBridge detects it's running on the Mac. The button changes to **SEND TO PHONE**. It also displays an incoming feed of everything you dictate.**Mac ****        →\to→
      **** Phone Text Push**:Paste any link, code snippet, or paragraph into VoiceBridge on your Mac and click **SEND TO PHONE**.Your phone immediately chimes, vibrates, and displays an **"Incoming from Mac"** card with a one-tap **COPY** button or inserts it right into your phone's box.

        .header-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .icon-btn {
            background: var(--chip-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            color: var(--text);
            font-size: 14px;
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            cursor: pointer;
        }
        .icon-btn:active { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; }
        .tag-counter {
            font-size: 11px;
            font-family: monospace;
            color: var(--text-dim);
            background: var(--chip-bg);
            padding: 3px 8px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
        }

        /* Incoming Notice Card */
        #incoming-card {
            display: none;
            margin: 10px 14px 0 14px;
            padding: 12px 14px;
            border-radius: 12px;
            background: var(--incoming-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--incoming-border);
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
            animation: slideDown 0.25s ease-out;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        @keyframes slideDown {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
        .incoming-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .incoming-body {
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.4;
            max-height: 90px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            word-break: break-word;
            user-select: text;
        }
        .incoming-actions {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
        }
        .mini-btn {
            padding: 4px 10px;
            font-size: 11px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            background: var(--panel);
            color: var(--text);
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        /* Workspace */
        main {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            padding: 10px 14px 4px 14px;
            gap: 8px;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        .textarea-wrapper {
            flex: 1;
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        textarea {
            flex: 1;
            width: 100%;
            background: var(--textarea-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            border-radius: 14px;
            color: var(--text);
            font-size: 17px;
            line-height: 1.55;
            padding: 14px;
            outline: none;
            resize: none;
            user-select: text;
            -webkit-user-select: text;
            font-family: inherit;
            transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
        }
        textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
        textarea::placeholder { color: var(--text-dim); opacity: 0.6; font-size: 15px; }

        /* Chips */
        .util-bar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
            overflow-x: auto;
            padding: 2px 0;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            scrollbar-width: none;
        }
        .util-bar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
        .chip {
            background: var(--chip-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--chip-border);
            color: var(--chip-text);
            font-size: 11px;
            font-family: monospace;
            padding: 6px 10px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            white-space: nowrap;
            transition: all 0.15s ease;
        }
        .chip:active { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; }
        .chip.toggle.active {
            background: var(--chip-active-bg);
            border-color: var(--accent-green);
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }

        /* Controls */
        footer {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 6px 14px 12px 14px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        button {
            border: none;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.15s ease;
            font-family: inherit;
        }
        .btn-secondary {
            background: var(--panel);
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-size: 12px;
            padding: 0 16px;
            height: 54px;
            min-width: 60px;
        }
        #action-btn {
            flex: 1;
            height: 54px;
            background: var(--accent);
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            box-shadow: 0 3px 16px var(--accent-glow);
        }
        #action-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }
        #action-btn.success { background: #00c853 !important; }

        /* History Drawer */
        #history-sheet {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            display: none;
            flex-direction: column;
            z-index: 100;
            padding: 20px;
        }
        #history-sheet.open { display: flex; }
        .history-list {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
            margin: 16px 0;
        }
        .history-item {
            background: var(--panel);
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 12px;
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.4;
            color: var(--text);
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: text;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="app-root">
        <header>
            <div class="brand">
                <div class="status-dot"></div>
                VoiceBridge
                <span class="device-badge" id="device-label">PHONE</span>
            </div>
            <div class="header-actions">
                <div class="tag-counter" id="counter">0w &bull; 0c</div>
                <button class="icon-btn" title="Reload page" onclick="window.location.reload()">&#x21bb;</button>
                <button class="chip" onclick="toggleHistory(true)">HISTORY</button>
            </div>
        </header>

        <!-- Dynamic card when Mac pushes text to Phone, or Phone dictates to Mac -->
        <div id="incoming-card">
            <div class="incoming-header">
                <span id="incoming-title">Incoming from Mac</span>
                <span style="font-size:10px; cursor:pointer;" onclick="closeIncoming()">&#x2715;</span>
            </div>
            <div class="incoming-body" id="incoming-text"></div>
            <div class="incoming-actions">
                <button class="mini-btn" onclick="copyIncoming()">COPY</button>
                <button class="mini-btn" onclick="insertIncoming()">INSERT TO BOX</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <main>
            <div class="textarea-wrapper">
                <textarea id="input" placeholder="Tap mic on Gboard to dictate..." autofocus></textarea>
            </div>

            <div class="util-bar">
                <button class="chip toggle active" id="btn-auto-enter" onclick="toggleAutoEnter()">+ ENTER ON MAC</button>
                <button class="chip" onclick="insertText('\\n')">+ LINE</button>
                <button class="chip" onclick="insertText('\\"\\"\\"')">+ CODE</button>
                <button class="chip" id="btn-undo" onclick="triggerMacUndo()">MAC UNDO</button>
            </div>
        </main>

        <footer>
            <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="clearText()">CLEAR</button>
            <button id="action-btn" onclick="handlePrimaryAction()">PASTE AT MAC CURSOR</button>
        </footer>
    </div>

    <!-- History Drawer -->
    <div id="history-sheet">
        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
            <div style="font-weight:800; letter-spacing:1.5px;">CLIPBOARD HISTORY</div>
            <button class="chip" onclick="toggleHistory(false)">CLOSE</button>
        </div>
        <div class="history-list" id="history-items"></div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const root = document.getElementById('app-root');
        const input = document.getElementById('input');
        const counter = document.getElementById('counter');
        const actionBtn = document.getElementById('action-btn');
        const deviceLabel = document.getElementById('device-label');
        const incomingCard = document.getElementById('incoming-card');
        const incomingTitle = document.getElementById('incoming-title');
        const incomingText = document.getElementById('incoming-text');

        let autoEnter = true;
        let lastReceivedTimestamp = 0;

        // Device Detection: Is user viewing this tab on the Mac laptop, or on phone?
        const isMacHost = window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || 
                          window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1' || 
                          (!/Android|iPhone|iPad/i.test(navigator.userAgent));

        if (isMacHost) {
            deviceLabel.innerText = "MAC HOST";
            actionBtn.innerText = "SEND TO PHONE";
            input.placeholder = "Type or paste on Mac to send over to your phone...";
            document.getElementById('btn-auto-enter').style.display = 'none';
            document.getElementById('btn-undo').style.display = 'none';
        } else {
            deviceLabel.innerText = "PHONE";
            actionBtn.innerText = "PASTE AT MAC CURSOR";
            input.placeholder = "Tap mic on Gboard to dictate...";
        }

        // VisualViewport Docking for Mobile Keyboard
        function updateViewport() {
            if (window.visualViewport && !isMacHost) {
                root.style.height = window.visualViewport.height + 'px';
            }
        }
        if (window.visualViewport) {
            window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', updateViewport);
            window.visualViewport.addEventListener('scroll', updateViewport);
            updateViewport();
        }

        // Automatic Theme Syncing
        const colorSchemeQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
        function handleThemeChange(e) {
            const metaTheme = document.getElementById('meta-theme-color');
            if (metaTheme) metaTheme.setAttribute('content', e.matches ? '#070a0e' : '#f8fafc');
        }
        colorSchemeQuery.addEventListener('change', handleThemeChange);
        handleThemeChange(colorSchemeQuery);

        // Sound Synthesis (WebAudio)
        const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        function playChime(freq = 600, duration = 0.08) {
            try {
                if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
                const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
                osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 1.5, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, audioCtx.currentTime);
                gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                osc.start();
                osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        input.addEventListener('input', updateCount);

        function updateCount() {
            const val = input.value.trim();
            const chars = input.value.length;
            const words = val ? val.split(/\\s+/).length : 0;
            counter.innerHTML = `${words}w &bull; ${chars}c`;
        }

        function clearText() {
            input.value = '';
            updateCount();
            input.focus();
        }

        function insertText(str) {
            const start = input.selectionStart;
            const end = input.selectionEnd;
            input.value = input.value.substring(0, start) + str + input.value.substring(end);
            input.selectionStart = input.selectionEnd = start + str.length;
            updateCount();
            input.focus();
        }

        function toggleAutoEnter() {
            autoEnter = !autoEnter;
            document.getElementById('btn-auto-enter').classList.toggle('active', autoEnter);
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(20);
        }

        function triggerMacUndo() {
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(25);
            fetch('/undo', { method: 'POST' });
        }

        // Two-Way Action Handler
        function handlePrimaryAction() {
            const text = input.value;
            if (!text.trim()) return;

            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(30);
            playChime(isMacHost ? 680 : 540);

            actionBtn.classList.add('success');
            const originalText = actionBtn.innerText;
            actionBtn.innerText = 'SENT!';

            if (isMacHost) {
                // Mac pushes text to phone
                fetch('/send-to-phone', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ text: text })
                }).then(() => {
                    input.value = '';
                    updateCount();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        actionBtn.classList.remove('success');
                        actionBtn.innerText = originalText;
                    }, 500);
                });
            } else {
                // Phone pastes directly into active Mac cursor
                fetch('/paste', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ text: text, autoEnter: autoEnter })
                }).then(() => {
                    input.value = '';
                    updateCount();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        actionBtn.classList.remove('success');
                        actionBtn.innerText = originalText;
                        input.focus();
                    }, 500);
                }).catch(() => {
                    actionBtn.classList.remove('success');
                    actionBtn.innerText = 'FAILED TO REACH MAC';
                    setTimeout(() => { actionBtn.innerText = originalText; }, 1500);
                });
            }
        }

        // Live Poll for Two-Way sync
        function pollSync() {
            fetch('/poll?is_mac=' + (isMacHost ? '1' : '0'))
                .then(r => r.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data && data.text && data.timestamp > lastReceivedTimestamp) {
                        lastReceivedTimestamp = data.timestamp;
                        if (data.from !== (isMacHost ? 'mac' : 'phone')) {
                            showIncoming(data.text, data.from === 'mac' ? 'From Mac' : 'From Phone');
                        }
                    }
                })
                .catch(() => {})
                .finally(() => {
                    setTimeout(pollSync, 1200);
                });
        }
        pollSync();

        function showIncoming(txt, sourceName) {
            incomingTitle.innerText = sourceName;
            incomingText.innerText = txt;
            incomingCard.style.display = 'flex';
            playChime(750, 0.12);
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate([30, 50, 30]);
        }

        function closeIncoming() {
            incomingCard.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function copyIncoming() {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(incomingText.innerText);
            closeIncoming();
        }

        function insertIncoming() {
            insertText(incomingText.innerText);
            closeIncoming();
        }

        // History
        function toggleHistory(open) {
            const sheet = document.getElementById('history-sheet');
            sheet.classList.toggle('open', open);
            if (open) {
                fetch('/history')
                    .then(r => r.json())
                    .then(items => {
                        const list = document.getElementById('history-items');
                        if (!items || items.length === 0) {
                            list.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--text-dim); text-align:center; margin-top:40px;">No history yet.</div>';
                            return;
                        }
                        list.innerHTML = items.map(it => `
                            <div class="history-item" onclick="insertText(\`${encodeURIComponent(it.text)}\`); toggleHistory(false);">
                                <div style="font-size:10px; color:var(--text-dim); margin-bottom:4px;">${it.from.toUpperCase()} &bull; ${it.time}</div>
                                ${it.text.length > 120 ? it.text.substring(0, 120) + '...' : it.text}
                            </div>
                        `).join('');
                    });
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
"""

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path.startswith('/poll'):
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header('Content-type', 'application/json')
            self.end_headers()
            data = {
                "text": SERVER_STATE["to_phone"],
                "timestamp": SERVER_STATE["to_phone_time"],
                "from": "mac"
            }
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(data).encode('utf-8'))

        elif self.path == '/history':
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header('Content-type', 'application/json')
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(SERVER_STATE["history"]).encode('utf-8'))

        else:
            self.send_response(200)
            self.send_header('Content-type', 'text/html; charset=utf-8')
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(HTML.encode('utf-8'))

    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8')) if length > 0 else {}

        if self.path == '/paste':
            text = body.get('text', '')
            auto_enter = body.get('autoEnter', False)

            if text:
                # 1. Instantly copy to Mac clipboard and inject
                p = subprocess.Popen(['pbcopy'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
                p.communicate(text.encode('utf-8'))

                script = 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "v" using command down'
                if auto_enter:
                    script += '\ntell application "System Events" to key code 36'
                subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', script])

                # Record in history
                SERVER_STATE["history"].insert(0, {
                    "text": text,
                    "from": "phone",
                    "time": time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                })
                if len(SERVER_STATE["history"]) > 10:
                    SERVER_STATE["history"].pop()

            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()

        elif self.path == '/send-to-phone':
            text = body.get('text', '')
            if text:
                SERVER_STATE["to_phone"] = text
                SERVER_STATE["to_phone_time"] = time.time()
                SERVER_STATE["history"].insert(0, {
                    "text": text,
                    "from": "mac",
                    "time": time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                })
                if len(SERVER_STATE["history"]) > 10:
                    SERVER_STATE["history"].pop()

            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()

        elif self.path == '/undo':
            script = 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "z" using command down'
            subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', script])
            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        return

if __name__ == '__main__':
    port = 5050
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    try:
        s.connect(('8.8.8.8', 80))
        local_ip = s.getsockname()[0]
    except Exception:
        local_ip = 'localhost'
    finally:
        s.close()

    print(f"VoiceBridge live: http://{local_ip}:{port}")
    HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', port), Handler).serve_forever()
```

### Apply the Update (One command in Terminal):

```
launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.voicebridge.plist
launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.voicebridge.plist
```

Now reload both tabs:

* In the top header, you'll see a dedicated **⟳** reload button right next to History.On your **Mac**, it will say MAC HOST and the button changes to **SEND TO PHONE**. Type any text on your Mac and hit send—your phone will immediately pop up an incoming card with a **COPY** or **INSERT** button.On your **Pixel**, it says PHONE and remains your high-speed dictation bridge to your active Mac cursor.

---

**Model:**

Model 3:40 AMTwo exact things happened here:

1. **The Mac was showing the cached old version**: Chrome cached the previous webpage in memory, so it was still running the old 1-way code. We need Cache-Control: no-cache so it always serves the fresh version instantly.**The keyboard bounce on your Pixel**: When you tap the blue button on a mobile screen, the text box briefly loses focus (causing Gboard to start closing), and then a timer called .focus() half a second later, forcing Gboard to pop right back up.
By intercepting the touch event (pointerdown with preventDefault), **the text box never loses focus in the first place**. Gboard stays locked open on your screen with zero jumping.

We also added a clean **mode switcher in the top bar** (📱 PHONE vs 💻 MAC) so you can switch modes on any device anytime without relying on automatic browser detection.

### The Updated voicebridge.py

In Antigravity IDE, replace everything in voicebridge.py with this code and hit **Cmd + S**:

SERVER_STATE = {

    "history": []
}

HTML = """<!DOCTYPE html>

            background: var(--incoming-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--incoming-border);
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
            animation: slideDown 0.2s ease-out;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        @keyframes slideDown {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
        .incoming-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .incoming-body {
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.4;
            max-height: 100px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            word-break: break-word;
            user-select: text;
        }
        .incoming-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
        .mini-btn {
            padding: 5px 12px;
            font-size: 11px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            background: var(--panel);
            color: var(--text);
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        main {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            padding: 10px 14px 4px 14px;
            gap: 8px;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        .textarea-wrapper {
            flex: 1;
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        textarea {
            flex: 1;
            width: 100%;
            background: var(--textarea-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            border-radius: 14px;
            color: var(--text);
            font-size: 17px;
            line-height: 1.55;
            padding: 14px;
            outline: none;
            resize: none;
            user-select: text;
            -webkit-user-select: text;
            font-family: inherit;
            transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
        }
        textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
        textarea::placeholder { color: var(--text-dim); opacity: 0.6; font-size: 15px; }

        .util-bar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
            overflow-x: auto;
            padding: 2px 0;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            scrollbar-width: none;

        .util-bar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
        .chip {

            font-family: monospace;

        .chip.toggle.active {

            background: var(--panel);
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);

            box-shadow: 0 3px 16px var(--accent-glow);
        }
        #action-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }
        #action-btn.success { background: #00c853 !important; }

        #history-sheet {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            display: none;
            flex-direction: column;
            z-index: 100;
            padding: 20px;
        }
        #history-sheet.open { display: flex; }
        .history-list {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
            margin: 16px 0;
        }
        .history-item {
            background: var(--panel);
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 12px;
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.4;
            color: var(--text);
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: text;
