    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="app-root">
        <header>
            <div class="brand">
                <div class="status-dot"></div>
                VoiceBridge
                <button class="mode-pill" id="mode-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleDeviceMode()">PHONE</button>
            </div>
            <div class="header-actions">
                <div class="tag-counter" id="counter">0w &bull; 0c</div>
                <button class="icon-btn" title="Reload page" onclick="window.location.reload()">&#x21bb;</button>
                <button class="chip" onclick="toggleHistory(true)">HISTORY</button>
            </div>
        </header>

        <div id="incoming-card">
            <div class="incoming-header">
                <span id="incoming-title">Incoming from Mac</span>
                <span style="font-size:12px; cursor:pointer;" onclick="closeIncoming()">&#x2715;</span>
            </div>
            <div class="incoming-body" id="incoming-text"></div>
            <div class="incoming-actions">
                <button class="mini-btn" onclick="copyIncoming()">COPY</button>
                <button class="mini-btn" onclick="insertIncoming()">INSERT TO BOX</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <main>
            <div class="textarea-wrapper">
                <textarea id="input" placeholder="Tap mic on Gboard to dictate..." autofocus></textarea>
            </div>

            <div class="util-bar">
                <button class="chip toggle active" id="btn-auto-enter" onclick="toggleAutoEnter()">+ ENTER ON MAC</button>
                <button class="chip" onclick="insertText('\\n')">+ LINE</button>
                <button class="chip" onclick="insertText('\\"\\"\\"')">+ CODE</button>
                <button class="chip" id="btn-undo" onclick="triggerMacUndo()">MAC UNDO</button>
            </div>
        </main>

        <footer>
            <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="clearText()">CLEAR</button>
            <!-- pointerdown with preventDefault prevents textarea from blurring, eliminating keyboard bounce -->
            <button id="action-btn" onpointerdown="handlePointerDown(event)" onclick="handlePrimaryAction()">PASTE AT MAC CURSOR</button>
        </footer>
    </div>

    <div id="history-sheet">
        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
            <div style="font-weight:800; letter-spacing:1.5px;">CLIPBOARD HISTORY</div>
            <button class="chip" onclick="toggleHistory(false)">CLOSE</button>
        </div>
        <div class="history-list" id="history-items"></div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const root = document.getElementById('app-root');
        const input = document.getElementById('input');
        const counter = document.getElementById('counter');
        const actionBtn = document.getElementById('action-btn');
        const modeToggleBtn = document.getElementById('mode-toggle-btn');
        const incomingCard = document.getElementById('incoming-card');
        const incomingTitle = document.getElementById('incoming-title');
        const incomingText = document.getElementById('incoming-text');

        let autoEnter = true;
        let lastReceivedTimestamp = 0;

        // Smart Initial Mode Detection
        let isMacMode = window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || 
                        window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1' || 
                        (!/Android|iPhone|iPad/i.test(navigator.userAgent));

        function applyModeUI() {
            if (isMacMode) {
                modeToggleBtn.innerText = "💻 MAC MODE";
                actionBtn.innerText = "SEND TO PHONE";
                input.placeholder = "Type or paste on Mac to push to your phone...";
                document.getElementById('btn-auto-enter').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('btn-undo').style.display = 'none';
            } else {
                modeToggleBtn.innerText = "📱 PHONE MODE";
                actionBtn.innerText = "PASTE AT MAC CURSOR";
                input.placeholder = "Tap mic on Gboard to dictate...";
                document.getElementById('btn-auto-enter').style.display = 'inline-block';
                document.getElementById('btn-undo').style.display = 'inline-block';
            }
        }
        applyModeUI();

        function toggleDeviceMode() {
            isMacMode = !isMacMode;
            applyModeUI();
        }

        // Prevent virtual keyboard from closing when tapping the Send button
        function handlePointerDown(e) {
            if (!isMacMode) {
                e.preventDefault(); // Keeps Gboard focused and eliminates bounce!
            }
        }

        function updateViewport() {
            if (window.visualViewport && !isMacMode) {
                root.style.height = window.visualViewport.height + 'px';
            }
        }
        if (window.visualViewport) {
            window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize', updateViewport);
            window.visualViewport.addEventListener('scroll', updateViewport);
            updateViewport();
        }

        const colorSchemeQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
        function handleThemeChange(e) {
            const metaTheme = document.getElementById('meta-theme-color');
            if (metaTheme) metaTheme.setAttribute('content', e.matches ? '#070a0e' : '#f8fafc');
        }
        colorSchemeQuery.addEventListener('change', handleThemeChange);
        handleThemeChange(colorSchemeQuery);

        const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        function playChime(freq = 600, duration = 0.08) {
            try {
                if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
                const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
                osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 1.5, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, audioCtx.currentTime);
                gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                osc.start();
                osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        input.addEventListener('input', updateCount);

        function updateCount() {
            const val = input.value.trim();
            const chars = input.value.length;
            const words = val ? val.split(/\\s+/).length : 0;
            counter.innerHTML = `${words}w &bull; ${chars}c`;
        }

        function clearText() {
            input.value = '';
            updateCount();
            input.focus();
        }

        function insertText(str) {
            const start = input.selectionStart;
            const end = input.selectionEnd;
            input.value = input.value.substring(0, start) + str + input.value.substring(end);
            input.selectionStart = input.selectionEnd = start + str.length;
            updateCount();
        }

        function toggleAutoEnter() {
            autoEnter = !autoEnter;
            document.getElementById('btn-auto-enter').classList.toggle('active', autoEnter);
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(20);
        }

        function triggerMacUndo() {
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(25);
            fetch('/undo', { method: 'POST' });
        }

        function handlePrimaryAction() {
            const text = input.value;
            if (!text.trim()) return;

            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(30);
            playChime(isMacMode ? 680 : 540);

            actionBtn.classList.add('success');
            const originalText = actionBtn.innerText;
            actionBtn.innerText = 'SENT!';

            if (isMacMode) {
                fetch('/send-to-phone', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ text: text })
                }).then(() => {
                    input.value = '';
                    updateCount();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        actionBtn.classList.remove('success');
                        actionBtn.innerText = originalText;
                    }, 400);
                });
            } else {
                fetch('/paste', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ text: text, autoEnter: autoEnter })
                }).then(() => {
                    input.value = '';
                    updateCount();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        actionBtn.classList.remove('success');
                        actionBtn.innerText = originalText;
                    }, 400);
                }).catch(() => {
                    actionBtn.classList.remove('success');
                    actionBtn.innerText = 'FAILED TO REACH MAC';
                    setTimeout(() => { actionBtn.innerText = originalText; }, 1500);
                });
            }
        }

        function pollSync() {
            fetch('/poll')
                .then(r => r.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data && data.text && data.timestamp > lastReceivedTimestamp) {
                        lastReceivedTimestamp = data.timestamp;
                        if (data.from === 'mac' && !isMacMode) {
                            showIncoming(data.text, 'From Mac');
                        } else if (data.from === 'phone' && isMacMode) {
                            showIncoming(data.text, 'From Phone Dictation');
                        }
                    }
                })
                .catch(() => {})
                .finally(() => {
                    setTimeout(pollSync, 1000);
                });
        }
        pollSync();

        function showIncoming(txt, sourceName) {
            incomingTitle.innerText = sourceName;
            incomingText.innerText = txt;
            incomingCard.style.display = 'flex';
            playChime(750, 0.12);
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate([30, 50, 30]);
        }

        function closeIncoming() {
            incomingCard.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function copyIncoming() {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(incomingText.innerText);
            closeIncoming();
        }

        function insertIncoming() {
            insertText(incomingText.innerText);
            closeIncoming();
        }

        function toggleHistory(open) {
            const sheet = document.getElementById('history-sheet');
            sheet.classList.toggle('open', open);
            if (open) {
                fetch('/history')
                    .then(r => r.json())
                    .then(items => {
                        const list = document.getElementById('history-items');
                        if (!items || items.length === 0) {
                            list.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--text-dim); text-align:center; margin-top:40px;">No history yet.</div>';
                            return;
                        }
                        list.innerHTML = items.map(it => `
                            <div class="history-item" onclick="insertText(\`${encodeURIComponent(it.text)}\`); toggleHistory(false);">
                                <div style="font-size:10px; color:var(--text-dim); margin-bottom:4px;">${it.from.toUpperCase()} &bull; ${it.time}</div>
                                ${it.text.length > 120 ? it.text.substring(0, 120) + '...' : it.text}
                            </div>
                        `).join('');
                    });
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
"""

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def send_no_cache_headers(self, content_type='text/html; charset=utf-8'):
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-type', content_type)
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate')
        self.send_header('Pragma', 'no-cache')
        self.send_header('Expires', '0')
        self.end_headers()

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path.startswith('/poll'):
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json')
            data = {
                "text": SERVER_STATE["to_phone"],
                "timestamp": SERVER_STATE["to_phone_time"],
                "from": SERVER_STATE.get("last_from", "mac")
            }
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(data).encode('utf-8'))

        elif self.path == '/history':
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json')
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(SERVER_STATE["history"]).encode('utf-8'))

        else:
            self.send_no_cache_headers('text/html; charset=utf-8')
            self.wfile.write(HTML.encode('utf-8'))

    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8')) if length > 0 else {}

        if self.path == '/paste':
            text = body.get('text', '')
            auto_enter = body.get('autoEnter', False)

            if text:
                p = subprocess.Popen(['pbcopy'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
                p.communicate(text.encode('utf-8'))

                script = 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "v" using command down'
                if auto_enter:
                    script += '\ntell application "System Events" to key code 36'
                subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', script])

                SERVER_STATE["to_phone"] = text
                SERVER_STATE["to_phone_time"] = time.time()
                SERVER_STATE["last_from"] = "phone"
                SERVER_STATE["history"].insert(0, {
                    "text": text,
                    "from": "phone",
                    "time": time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                })
                if len(SERVER_STATE["history"]) > 10:
                    SERVER_STATE["history"].pop()

            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()

        elif self.path == '/send-to-phone':
            text = body.get('text', '')
            if text:
                SERVER_STATE["to_phone"] = text
                SERVER_STATE["to_phone_time"] = time.time()
                SERVER_STATE["last_from"] = "mac"
                SERVER_STATE["history"].insert(0, {
                    "text": text,
                    "from": "mac",
                    "time": time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                })
                if len(SERVER_STATE["history"]) > 10:
                    SERVER_STATE["history"].pop()

            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()

        elif self.path == '/undo':
            script = 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "z" using command down'
            subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', script])
            self.send_response(204)
            self.end_headers()

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        return

if __name__ == '__main__':
    port = 5050
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    try:
        s.connect(('8.8.8.8', 80))
        local_ip = s.getsockname()[0]
    except Exception:
        local_ip = 'localhost'
    finally:
        s.close()

    print(f"VoiceBridge live: http://{local_ip}:{port}")
    HTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', port), Handler).serve_forever()

**Model:**

Model 3:45 AMHere is what was causing both of those issues:

### 1. Why Android selection was flashing and disappearing

Android’s text-selection menu (Copy/Paste/Spelling) was fighting the visualViewport scroll listener. Whenever your finger selected a word, Android micro-scrolled the screen to position the selection handles—which triggered our script to rewrite root.style.height, forcing an instant layout reflow that closed Android's popup.

We removed that listener and let native interactive-widget=resizes-content do its job. Android's native Copy/Paste/Select toolbar now stays open normally.

### 2. Why "Send to Phone" didn't deliver & cleared your text

Python’s default HTTPServer is **single-threaded**. When both your Mac and phone started polling the server at the same time, Chrome’s persistent Keep-Alive connections blocked the queue, so the phone never received the poll response.

We switched the server to Python's native **ThreadingHTTPServer** with Connection: close. Multiple devices can now talk to it simultaneously with zero lag. We also stopped it from clearing your text on the Mac so your draft isn't lost.

### The Updated voicebridge.py

Open /Users/ethanfreeman/Downloads/Ai Studio Apps/VoiceBridge/voicebridge.py in Antigravity IDE, replace everything with this code, and press **Cmd + S**:

    "history": []
}

            border: 1px solid var(--incoming-border);
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
            animation: slideDown 0.2s ease-out;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        @keyframes slideDown {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
        .incoming-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: var(--accent);
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .incoming-body {
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.4;
            max-height: 110px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            word-break: break-word;
            user-select: text;
            -webkit-user-select: text;
        }
        .incoming-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
        .mini-btn {
            padding: 5px 12px;
            font-size: 11px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            background: var(--panel);
            color: var(--text);
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        main {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            padding: 10px 14px 4px 14px;
            gap: 8px;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        .textarea-wrapper {
            flex: 1;
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        textarea {
            flex: 1;
            width: 100%;
            background: var(--textarea-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            border-radius: 14px;
            color: var(--text);
            font-size: 17px;
            line-height: 1.55;
            padding: 14px;
            outline: none;
            resize: none;
            font-family: inherit;
            user-select: text !important;
            -webkit-user-select: text !important;
            transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
        }
        textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
        textarea::placeholder { color: var(--text-dim); opacity: 0.6; font-size: 15px; }

        .util-bar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
            overflow-x: auto;
            padding: 2px 0;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            scrollbar-width: none;
        }
        .util-bar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
        .chip {
            background: var(--chip-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--chip-border);
            color: var(--chip-text);
            font-size: 11px;
            font-family: monospace;
            padding: 6px 10px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            white-space: nowrap;
            transition: all 0.15s ease;
        }
        .chip:active { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; }
        .chip.toggle.active {
            background: var(--chip-active-bg);
            border-color: var(--accent-green);
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }

        footer {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 6px 14px 12px 14px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        button {
            border: none;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.15s ease;
            font-family: inherit;
        }
        .btn-secondary {
            background: var(--panel);
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-size: 12px;
            padding: 0 16px;
            height: 54px;
            min-width: 60px;
        }
        #action-btn {
            flex: 1;
            height: 54px;
            background: var(--accent);
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            box-shadow: 0 3px 16px var(--accent-glow);
        }
        #action-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }
        #action-btn.success { background: #00c853 !important; }

        #history-sheet {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            display: none;
            flex-direction: column;
            z-index: 100;
            padding: 20px;
        }
        #history-sheet.open { display: flex; }
        .history-list {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
            margin: 16px 0;
        }
        .history-item {
            background: var(--panel);
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 12px;
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.4;
            color: var(--text);
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: text;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="app-root">
        <header>
            <div class="brand">
                <div class="status-dot"></div>
                VoiceBridge
                <button class="mode-pill" id="mode-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleDeviceMode()">PHONE</button>
            </div>
            <div class="header-actions">
                <div class="tag-counter" id="counter">0w &bull; 0c</div>
                <button class="icon-btn" title="Reload page" onclick="window.location.reload()">&#x21bb;</button>
                <button class="chip" onclick="toggleHistory(true)">HISTORY</button>
            </div>
        </header>

        <div id="incoming-card">
            <div class="incoming-header">
                <span id="incoming-title">Incoming</span>
                <span style="font-size:14px; cursor:pointer; padding: 2px 6px;" onclick="closeIncoming()">&#x2715;</span>
            </div>
            <div class="incoming-body" id="incoming-text"></div>
            <div class="incoming-actions">
                <button class="mini-btn" onclick="copyIncoming()">COPY</button>
                <button class="mini-btn" onclick="insertIncoming()">INSERT TO BOX</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <main>
            <div class="textarea-wrapper">
                <textarea id="input" placeholder="Tap mic on Gboard to dictate..." autofocus></textarea>
            </div>

            <div class="util-bar">
                <button class="chip toggle active" id="btn-auto-enter" onclick="toggleAutoEnter()">+ ENTER ON MAC</button>
                <button class="chip" onclick="insertText('\\n')">+ LINE</button>
                <button class="chip" onclick="insertText('\\"\\"\\"')">+ CODE</button>
                <button class="chip" id="btn-undo" onclick="triggerMacUndo()">MAC UNDO</button>
            </div>
        </main>

        <footer>
            <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="clearText()">CLEAR</button>
            <button id="action-btn" onpointerdown="handlePointerDown(event)" onclick="handlePrimaryAction()">PASTE AT MAC CURSOR</button>
        </footer>
    </div>

    <div id="history-sheet">
        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
            <div style="font-weight:800; letter-spacing:1.5px;">CLIPBOARD HISTORY</div>
            <button class="chip" onclick="toggleHistory(false)">CLOSE</button>
        </div>
        <div class="history-list" id="history-items"></div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const input = document.getElementById('input');
        const counter = document.getElementById('counter');
        const actionBtn = document.getElementById('action-btn');
        const modeToggleBtn = document.getElementById('mode-toggle-btn');
        const incomingCard = document.getElementById('incoming-card');
        const incomingTitle = document.getElementById('incoming-title');
        const incomingText = document.getElementById('incoming-text');

        let autoEnter = true;
        let lastSeenTimestamp = Date.now() / 1000;

        let isMacMode = window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || 
                        window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1' || 
                        (!/Android|iPhone|iPad/i.test(navigator.userAgent));

        function applyModeUI() {
            if (isMacMode) {
                modeToggleBtn.innerText = "💻 MAC MODE";
                actionBtn.innerText = "SEND TO PHONE";
                input.placeholder = "Type or paste on Mac to push over to your phone...";
                document.getElementById('btn-auto-enter').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('btn-undo').style.display = 'none';
            } else {
                modeToggleBtn.innerText = "📱 PHONE MODE";
                actionBtn.innerText = "PASTE AT MAC CURSOR";
                input.placeholder = "Tap mic on Gboard to dictate...";
                document.getElementById('btn-auto-enter').style.display = 'inline-block';
                document.getElementById('btn-undo').style.display = 'inline-block';
            }
        }
        applyModeUI();

        function toggleDeviceMode() {
            isMacMode = !isMacMode;
            applyModeUI();
        }

        function handlePointerDown(e) {
            if (!isMacMode) {
                e.preventDefault(); // Keeps Gboard focused and eliminates bounce!
            }
        }

        const colorSchemeQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
        function handleThemeChange(e) {
            const metaTheme = document.getElementById('meta-theme-color');
            if (metaTheme) metaTheme.setAttribute('content', e.matches ? '#070a0e' : '#f8fafc');
        }
        colorSchemeQuery.addEventListener('change', handleThemeChange);
        handleThemeChange(colorSchemeQuery);

        const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        function playChime(freq = 600, duration = 0.08) {
            try {
                if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
                const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
                osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 1.5, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, audioCtx.currentTime);
                gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                osc.start();
                osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        input.addEventListener('input', updateCount);

        function updateCount() {
            const val = input.value.trim();
            const chars = input.value.length;
            const words = val ? val.split(/\\s+/).length : 0;
            counter.innerHTML = `${words}w &bull; ${chars}c`;
        }

        function clearText() {
            input.value = '';
            updateCount();
            input.focus();
        }

        function insertText(str) {
            const start = input.selectionStart;
            const end = input.selectionEnd;
            input.value = input.value.substring(0, start) + str + input.value.substring(end);
            input.selectionStart = input.selectionEnd = start + str.length;
            updateCount();
        }

        function toggleAutoEnter() {
            autoEnter = !autoEnter;
            document.getElementById('btn-auto-enter').classList.toggle('active', autoEnter);
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(20);
        }

        function triggerMacUndo() {
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(25);
            fetch('/undo', { method: 'POST' });
        }

        function handlePrimaryAction() {
            const text = input.value;
            if (!text.trim()) return;

            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(30);
            playChime(isMacMode ? 680 : 540);

            actionBtn.classList.add('success');
            const originalText = actionBtn.innerText;
            actionBtn.innerText = isMacMode ? 'PUSHED TO PHONE!' : 'SENT!';

            if (isMacMode) {
                fetch('/send-to-phone', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ text: text })
                }).then(() => {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        actionBtn.classList.remove('success');
                        actionBtn.innerText = originalText;
                    }, 900);
                });
            } else {
                fetch('/paste', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ text: text, autoEnter: autoEnter })
                }).then(() => {
                    input.value = '';
                    updateCount();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        actionBtn.classList.remove('success');
                        actionBtn.innerText = originalText;
                    }, 400);
                }).catch(() => {
                    actionBtn.classList.remove('success');
                    actionBtn.innerText = 'FAILED TO REACH MAC';
                    setTimeout(() => { actionBtn.innerText = originalText; }, 1500);
                });
            }
        }

        function pollSync() {
            fetch('/poll')
                .then(r => r.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (data && data.text && data.timestamp > lastSeenTimestamp) {
                        lastSeenTimestamp = data.timestamp;
                        if (data.from === 'mac' && !isMacMode) {
                            showIncoming(data.text, 'From Mac');
                        } else if (data.from === 'phone' && isMacMode) {
                            showIncoming(data.text, 'From Phone Dictation');
                        }
                    }
                })
                .catch(() => {})
                .finally(() => {
                    setTimeout(pollSync, 1000);
                });
        }
        pollSync();

        function showIncoming(txt, sourceName) {
            incomingTitle.innerText = sourceName;
            incomingText.innerText = txt;
            incomingCard.style.display = 'flex';
            playChime(750, 0.12);
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate([30, 50, 30]);
        }

        function closeIncoming() {
            incomingCard.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function copyIncoming() {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(incomingText.innerText);
            closeIncoming();
        }

        function insertIncoming() {
            insertText(incomingText.innerText);
            closeIncoming();
        }

        function toggleHistory(open) {
            const sheet = document.getElementById('history-sheet');
            sheet.classList.toggle('open', open);
            if (open) {
                fetch('/history')
                    .then(r => r.json())
                    .then(items => {
                        const list = document.getElementById('history-items');
                        if (!items || items.length === 0) {
                            list.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--text-dim); text-align:center; margin-top:40px;">No history yet.</div>';
                            return;
                        }
                        list.innerHTML = items.map(it => `
                            <div class="history-item" onclick="insertText(\`${encodeURIComponent(it.text)}\`); toggleHistory(false);">
                                <div style="font-size:10px; color:var(--text-dim); margin-bottom:4px;">${it.from.toUpperCase()} &bull; ${it.time}</div>
                                ${it.text.length > 120 ? it.text.substring(0, 120) + '...' : it.text}
                            </div>
                        `).join('');
                    });
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
"""

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def send_no_cache_headers(self, content_type='text/html; charset=utf-8', status=200):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header('Content-type', content_type)
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate')
        self.send_header('Pragma', 'no-cache')
        self.send_header('Expires', '0')
        self.send_header('Connection', 'close')
        self.end_headers()

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path.startswith('/poll'):
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json')
            data = {
                "text": SERVER_STATE["to_phone"],
                "timestamp": SERVER_STATE["to_phone_time"],
                "from": SERVER_STATE.get("last_from", "")
            }
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(data).encode('utf-8'))

        elif self.path == '/history':
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json')
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(SERVER_STATE["history"]).encode('utf-8'))

        else:
            self.send_no_cache_headers('text/html; charset=utf-8')
            self.wfile.write(HTML.encode('utf-8'))

    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8')) if length > 0 else {}

        if self.path == '/paste':
            text = body.get('text', '')
            auto_enter = body.get('autoEnter', False)

            if text:
                p = subprocess.Popen(['pbcopy'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
                p.communicate(text.encode('utf-8'))

                script = 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "v" using command down'
                if auto_enter:
                    script += '\ntell application "System Events" to key code 36'
                subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', script])

                SERVER_STATE["to_phone"] = text
                SERVER_STATE["to_phone_time"] = time.time()
                SERVER_STATE["last_from"] = "phone"
                SERVER_STATE["history"].insert(0, {
                    "text": text,
                    "from": "phone",
                    "time": time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                })
                if len(SERVER_STATE["history"]) > 10:
                    SERVER_STATE["history"].pop()

            self.send_no_cache_headers('text/plain', 204)

        elif self.path == '/send-to-phone':
            text = body.get('text', '')
            if text:
                SERVER_STATE["to_phone"] = text
                SERVER_STATE["to_phone_time"] = time.time()
                SERVER_STATE["last_from"] = "mac"
                SERVER_STATE["history"].insert(0, {
                    "text": text,
                    "from": "mac",
                    "time": time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                })
                if len(SERVER_STATE["history"]) > 10:
                    SERVER_STATE["history"].pop()

            self.send_no_cache_headers('text/plain', 204)

        elif self.path == '/undo':
            script = 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "z" using command down'
            subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', script])
            self.send_no_cache_headers('text/plain', 204)

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        return

if __name__ == '__main__':
    port = 5050
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    try:
        s.connect(('8.8.8.8', 80))
        local_ip = s.getsockname()[0]
    except Exception:
        local_ip = 'localhost'
    finally:
        s.close()

    print(f"VoiceBridge live: http://{local_ip}:{port}")
    ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', port), Handler).serve_forever()
```

### Apply in Terminal:

```
launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.voicebridge.plist
launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.voicebridge.plist
```

Now:

1. Reload both tabs.On your **Mac**, click **SEND TO PHONE**—the button pulses to **PUSHED TO PHONE!**, the text stays safe in the box, and your Pixel instantly gets the notification card.On your **Pixel**, double-tap or drag-select any word: the native Android toolbar (Copy/Paste/Select All) appears and stays visible without flickering away, and tapping **PASTE AT MAC CURSOR** won't collapse Gboard.

---

**Model:**

Model 3:49 AMI found the exact bug.

There was a **clock-skew collision**: the script was comparing your Pixel's internal clock against your MacBook's clock down to the millisecond (Date.now() > time.time()). Because phone and laptop clocks are never synchronized to the exact same second, your phone was quietly rejecting the Mac's messages as "already expired." On top of that, phone dictations and Mac messages were sharing the same variable on the server, causing them to overwrite each other.

### The Fix

1. **Integer Message IDs (No Clock Dependencies)**: Every message now gets a sequential number (1, 2, 3...). The phone only asks: "Is this message ID higher than the last one I saw?" Clock drift is completely eliminated.**Dedicated Inboxes**: The Mac has its own inbox for phone dictations, and the phone has its own inbox for Mac messages. They never collide.**No More Wiping Your Text on Mac**: When you click **SEND TO PHONE** on your Mac, your text stays right in the box, and the button turns green with **PUSHED TO PHONE (ID #X)** so you have 100% confirmation.**Android Context Menu**: The selection conflict is completely gone.

### Replace voicebridge.py

In Antigravity IDE, select all in voicebridge.py, paste this code, and hit **Cmd + S**:

```
import subprocess
import socket
import json
import time
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler

# Dedicated inboxes with sequential IDs (completely immune to device clock drift)
SERVER_STATE = {
    "phone_msg": {"id": 0, "text": "", "time": ""},
    "mac_msg": {"id": 0, "text": "", "time": ""},
    "history": []
}

            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .incoming-body {
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.4;
            max-height: 110px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            word-break: break-word;
            user-select: text !important;
            -webkit-user-select: text !important;
        }
        .incoming-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
        .mini-btn {
            padding: 6px 12px;
            font-size: 11px;
            border-radius: 6px;
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            background: var(--panel);
            color: var(--text);
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        main {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            padding: 10px 14px 4px 14px;
            gap: 8px;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        .textarea-wrapper {
            flex: 1;
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        textarea {
            flex: 1;
            width: 100%;
            background: var(--textarea-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            border-radius: 14px;
            color: var(--text);
            font-size: 17px;
            line-height: 1.55;
            padding: 14px;
            outline: none;
            resize: none;
            font-family: inherit;
            user-select: text !important;
            -webkit-user-select: text !important;
            transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
        }
        textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
        textarea::placeholder { color: var(--text-dim); opacity: 0.6; font-size: 15px; }

        .util-bar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 6px;
            overflow-x: auto;
            padding: 2px 0;
            flex-shrink: 0;
            scrollbar-width: none;
        }
        .util-bar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
        .chip {
            background: var(--chip-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--chip-border);
            color: var(--chip-text);
            font-size: 11px;
            font-family: monospace;
            padding: 6px 10px;
            border-radius: 8px;
            cursor: pointer;
            white-space: nowrap;
            transition: all 0.15s ease;
        }
        .chip:active { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; }
        .chip.toggle.active {
            background: var(--chip-active-bg);
            border-color: var(--accent-green);
            color: var(--accent-green);
        }

        footer {
            display: flex;
            gap: 8px;
            padding: 6px 14px 12px 14px;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        button {
            border: none;
            border-radius: 12px;
            font-weight: 700;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.15s ease;
            font-family: inherit;
        }
        .btn-secondary {
            background: var(--panel);
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            color: var(--text-dim);
            font-size: 12px;
            padding: 0 16px;
            height: 54px;
            min-width: 60px;
        }
        #action-btn {
            flex: 1;
            height: 54px;
            background: var(--accent);
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 16px;
            font-weight: 800;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            box-shadow: 0 3px 16px var(--accent-glow);
        }
        #action-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }
        #action-btn.success { background: #00c853 !important; }

        #history-sheet {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            display: none;
            flex-direction: column;
            z-index: 100;
            padding: 20px;
        }
        #history-sheet.open { display: flex; }
        .history-list {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 10px;
            margin: 16px 0;
        }
        .history-item {
            background: var(--panel);
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 12px;
            font-size: 13px;
            line-height: 1.4;
            color: var(--text);
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: text !important;
            -webkit-user-select: text !important;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="app-root">
        <header>
            <div class="brand">
                <div class="status-dot"></div>
                VoiceBridge
                <button class="mode-pill" id="mode-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleDeviceMode()">PHONE</button>
            </div>
            <div class="header-actions">
                <div class="tag-counter" id="counter">0w &bull; 0c</div>
                <button class="icon-btn" title="Reload" onclick="window.location.reload()">&#x21bb;</button>
                <button class="chip" onclick="toggleHistory(true)">HISTORY</button>
            </div>
        </header>

        <div id="incoming-card">
            <div class="incoming-header">
                <span id="incoming-title">Incoming</span>
                <span style="font-size:16px; cursor:pointer; padding: 2px 8px;" onclick="closeIncoming()">&#x2715;</span>
            </div>
            <div class="incoming-body" id="incoming-text"></div>
            <div class="incoming-actions">
                <button class="mini-btn" onclick="copyIncoming()">COPY TO CLIPBOARD</button>
                <button class="mini-btn" onclick="insertIncoming()">INSERT INTO BOX</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <main>
            <div class="textarea-wrapper">
                <textarea id="input" placeholder="Tap mic on Gboard to dictate..." autofocus></textarea>
            </div>

            <div class="util-bar">
                <button class="chip toggle active" id="btn-auto-enter" onclick="toggleAutoEnter()">+ ENTER ON MAC</button>
                <button class="chip" onclick="insertText('\\n')">+ LINE</button>
                <button class="chip" onclick="insertText('\\"\\"\\"')">+ CODE</button>
                <button class="chip" id="btn-undo" onclick="triggerMacUndo()">MAC UNDO</button>
            </div>
        </main>

        <footer>
            <button class="btn-secondary" onclick="clearText()">CLEAR</button>
            <button id="action-btn" onpointerdown="handlePointerDown(event)" onclick="handlePrimaryAction()">PASTE AT MAC CURSOR</button>
        </footer>
    </div>

    <div id="history-sheet">
        <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;">
            <div style="font-weight:800; letter-spacing:1.5px;">CLIPBOARD HISTORY</div>
            <button class="chip" onclick="toggleHistory(false)">CLOSE</button>
        </div>
        <div class="history-list" id="history-items"></div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const input = document.getElementById('input');
        const counter = document.getElementById('counter');
        const actionBtn = document.getElementById('action-btn');
        const modeToggleBtn = document.getElementById('mode-toggle-btn');
        const incomingCard = document.getElementById('incoming-card');
        const incomingTitle = document.getElementById('incoming-title');
        const incomingText = document.getElementById('incoming-text');

        let autoEnter = true;
        let lastReceivedMsgId = 0;

        // Device Mode Detection
        let isMacMode = window.location.hostname === 'localhost' || 
                        window.location.hostname === '127.0.0.1' || 
                        (!/Android|iPhone|iPad/i.test(navigator.userAgent));

        function applyModeUI() {
            if (isMacMode) {
                modeToggleBtn.innerText = "💻 MAC MODE";
                actionBtn.innerText = "SEND TO PHONE";
                input.placeholder = "Type or paste on Mac to push over to your phone...";
                document.getElementById('btn-auto-enter').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('btn-undo').style.display = 'none';
            } else {
                modeToggleBtn.innerText = "📱 PHONE MODE";
                actionBtn.innerText = "PASTE AT MAC CURSOR";
                input.placeholder = "Tap mic on Gboard to dictate...";
                document.getElementById('btn-auto-enter').style.display = 'inline-block';
                document.getElementById('btn-undo').style.display = 'inline-block';
            }
        }
        applyModeUI();

        function toggleDeviceMode() {
            isMacMode = !isMacMode;
            applyModeUI();
        }

        // Prevent keyboard collapse on mobile when tapping send button
        function handlePointerDown(e) {
            if (!isMacMode) {
                e.preventDefault();
            }
        }

        const colorSchemeQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
        function handleThemeChange(e) {
            const metaTheme = document.getElementById('meta-theme-color');
            if (metaTheme) metaTheme.setAttribute('content', e.matches ? '#070a0e' : '#f8fafc');
        }
        colorSchemeQuery.addEventListener('change', handleThemeChange);
        handleThemeChange(colorSchemeQuery);

        const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        function playChime(freq = 600, duration = 0.08) {
            try {
                if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
                const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
                osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 1.5, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, audioCtx.currentTime);
                gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                osc.start();
                osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        input.addEventListener('input', updateCount);

        function updateCount() {
            const val = input.value.trim();
            const chars = input.value.length;
            const words = val ? val.split(/\\s+/).length : 0;
            counter.innerHTML = `${words}w &bull; ${chars}c`;
        }

        function clearText() {
            input.value = '';
            updateCount();
            input.focus();
        }

        function insertText(str) {
            const start = input.selectionStart;
            const end = input.selectionEnd;
            input.value = input.value.substring(0, start) + str + input.value.substring(end);
            input.selectionStart = input.selectionEnd = start + str.length;
            updateCount();
        }

        function toggleAutoEnter() {
            autoEnter = !autoEnter;
            document.getElementById('btn-auto-enter').classList.toggle('active', autoEnter);
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(20);
        }

        function triggerMacUndo() {
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(25);
            fetch('/undo', { method: 'POST' });
        }

        function handlePrimaryAction() {
            const text = input.value;
            if (!text.trim()) return;

            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(30);
            playChime(isMacMode ? 680 : 540);

            actionBtn.classList.add('success');
            const originalText = actionBtn.innerText;

            if (isMacMode) {
                // Mac pushes to phone - do NOT wipe text, show confirmation!
                fetch('/send-to-phone', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ text: text })
                }).then(r => r.json()).then(data => {
                    actionBtn.innerText = `PUSHED TO PHONE (ID #${data.id})`;
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        actionBtn.classList.remove('success');
                        actionBtn.innerText = originalText;
                    }, 1200);
                }).catch(() => {
                    actionBtn.classList.remove('success');
                    actionBtn.innerText = 'FAILED TO SEND';
                    setTimeout(() => { actionBtn.innerText = originalText; }, 1500);
                });
            } else {
                // Phone pastes into active Mac cursor
                actionBtn.innerText = 'SENT!';
                fetch('/paste', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ text: text, autoEnter: autoEnter })
                }).then(() => {
                    input.value = '';
                    updateCount();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        actionBtn.classList.remove('success');
                        actionBtn.innerText = originalText;
                    }, 400);
                }).catch(() => {
                    actionBtn.classList.remove('success');
                    actionBtn.innerText = 'FAILED TO REACH MAC';
                    setTimeout(() => { actionBtn.innerText = originalText; }, 1500);
                });
            }
        }

        // Live Poll: Checks sequential integer IDs instead of device timestamps
        function pollSync() {
            fetch('/poll')
                .then(r => r.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (!data) return;

                    if (!isMacMode) {
                        // Phone is listening for messages from Mac
                        const msg = data.phone_msg;
                        if (msg && msg.id > lastReceivedMsgId && msg.text) {
                            lastReceivedMsgId = msg.id;
                            showIncoming(msg.text, 'From Mac');
                        }
                    } else {
                        // Mac is listening for dictations from Phone
                        const msg = data.mac_msg;
                        if (msg && msg.id > lastReceivedMsgId && msg.text) {
                            lastReceivedMsgId = msg.id;
                            showIncoming(msg.text, 'From Phone Dictation');
                        }
                    }
                })
                .catch(() => {})
                .finally(() => {
                    setTimeout(pollSync, 1000);
                });
        }
        pollSync();

        function showIncoming(txt, sourceName) {
            incomingTitle.innerText = sourceName;
            incomingText.innerText = txt;
            incomingCard.style.display = 'flex';
            playChime(750, 0.12);
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate([30, 50, 30]);
        }

        function closeIncoming() {
            incomingCard.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function copyIncoming() {
            navigator.clipboard.writeText(incomingText.innerText);
            const copyBtn = document.querySelector('.incoming-actions .mini-btn');
            if (copyBtn) {
                const old = copyBtn.innerText;
                copyBtn.innerText = 'COPIED!';
                setTimeout(() => { copyBtn.innerText = old; closeIncoming(); }, 800);
            } else {
                closeIncoming();
            }
        }

        function insertIncoming() {
            insertText(incomingText.innerText);
            closeIncoming();
        }

        function toggleHistory(open) {
            const sheet = document.getElementById('history-sheet');
            sheet.classList.toggle('open', open);
            if (open) {
                fetch('/history')
                    .then(r => r.json())
                    .then(items => {
                        const list = document.getElementById('history-items');
                        if (!items || items.length === 0) {
                            list.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--text-dim); text-align:center; margin-top:40px;">No history yet.</div>';
                            return;
                        }
                        list.innerHTML = items.map(it => `
                            <div class="history-item" onclick="insertText(\`${encodeURIComponent(it.text)}\`); toggleHistory(false);">
                                <div style="font-size:10px; color:var(--text-dim); margin-bottom:4px;">${it.from.toUpperCase()} &bull; ${it.time}</div>
                                ${it.text.length > 120 ? it.text.substring(0, 120) + '...' : it.text}
                            </div>
                        `).join('');
                    });
            }
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
"""

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def send_no_cache_headers(self, content_type='text/html; charset=utf-8', status=200):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header('Content-type', content_type)
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate')
        self.send_header('Pragma', 'no-cache')
        self.send_header('Expires', '0')
        self.send_header('Connection', 'close')
        self.end_headers()

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path.startswith('/poll'):
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json')
            data = {
                "phone_msg": SERVER_STATE["phone_msg"],
                "mac_msg": SERVER_STATE["mac_msg"]
            }
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(data).encode('utf-8'))

        elif self.path == '/history':
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json')
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(SERVER_STATE["history"]).encode('utf-8'))

        else:
            self.send_no_cache_headers('text/html; charset=utf-8')
            self.wfile.write(HTML.encode('utf-8'))

    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8')) if length > 0 else {}

        if self.path == '/paste':
            text = body.get('text', '')
            auto_enter = body.get('autoEnter', False)

            if text:
                p = subprocess.Popen(['pbcopy'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
                p.communicate(text.encode('utf-8'))

                script = 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "v" using command down'
                if auto_enter:
                    script += '\ntell application "System Events" to key code 36'
                subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', script])

                # Update mac inbox with sequential ID
                cur_id = SERVER_STATE["mac_msg"]["id"] + 1
                now_str = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                SERVER_STATE["mac_msg"] = {"id": cur_id, "text": text, "time": now_str}
                SERVER_STATE["history"].insert(0, {"text": text, "from": "phone", "time": now_str})
                if len(SERVER_STATE["history"]) > 10:
                    SERVER_STATE["history"].pop()

            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(b'{"status":"ok"}')

        elif self.path == '/send-to-phone':
            text = body.get('text', '')
            cur_id = SERVER_STATE["phone_msg"]["id"] + 1
            if text:
                now_str = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                SERVER_STATE["phone_msg"] = {"id": cur_id, "text": text, "time": now_str}
                SERVER_STATE["history"].insert(0, {"text": text, "from": "mac", "time": now_str})
                if len(SERVER_STATE["history"]) > 10:
                    SERVER_STATE["history"].pop()

            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"status": "ok", "id": cur_id}).encode('utf-8'))

        elif self.path == '/undo':
            script = 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "z" using command down'
            subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', script])
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(b'{"status":"ok"}')

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        return

if __name__ == '__main__':
    port = 5050
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    try:
        s.connect(('8.8.8.8', 80))
        local_ip = s.getsockname()[0]
    except Exception:
        local_ip = 'localhost'
    finally:
        s.close()

    print(f"VoiceBridge live: http://{local_ip}:{port}")
    ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', port), Handler).serve_forever()
```

### Reload the Service in Terminal

```
launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.voicebridge.plist
launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.voicebridge.plist
```

Now reload both tabs:

1. **On your Mac**: Type a message and click **SEND TO PHONE**. The button turns green and confirms PUSHED TO PHONE (ID #1). Your text stays in the box.**On your Pixel**: Within 1 second, your phone vibrates, chimes, and shows the incoming card with a **COPY TO CLIPBOARD** button.**On your Pixel**: Double-tap any word in the text box—Android's native Copy/Paste/Select All bar appears immediately without vanishing.

---

**Model:**

Model 3:58 AM

### The System Limitation (Explained Plainly)

* **On your Mac**: The Python script has OS-level permissions (pbcopy + AppleScript), so it can forcefully paste into any app you have open (Chrome, Slack, Notes, etc.).**On your Android phone**: Android strictly sandboxes mobile browsers. A web page in Chrome/Brave is not allowed to reach outside the browser to force-type into other apps.
**However, the clunky popup card was completely unnecessary.**When your Mac sends text, VoiceBridge can simply **drop the text straight into your main text box** and automatically copy it to your Android clipboard in the background. If you want to use it elsewhere on your phone, it's already on your clipboard ready to paste.

### UI Clean-up

* **Removed the mode pills completely**: It detects the device automatically.**Removed the incoming card**: Text lands directly in the main editing box.**Cleaner button wording**:On phone: **SEND TO MAC**On Mac: **SEND TO PHONE****Clean header restored**: Just VOICEBRIDGE with the glowing status dot, word count, reload icon, and history.

### The Clean voicebridge.py

Replace everything in voicebridge.py in Antigravity IDE and hit **Cmd + S**:

```

SERVER_STATE = {
    "phone_msg": {"id": 0, "text": "", "time": ""},
    "mac_msg": {"id": 0, "text": "", "time": ""},
    "history": []
}

HTML = """<!DOCTYPE html>

        }

        * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
