            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .header-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
        .btn-header {
            background: rgba(125, 125, 125, 0.1); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            color: var(--text); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700;
            padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer;
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        }
        .btn-header:active { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent); }

        /* Incoming Card */
        #incoming-card {
            display: none; margin: 12px 14px 0 14px; padding: 14px 16px;
            border-radius: 12px; background: var(--card-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
            flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; flex-shrink: 0;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
            animation: slideDown 0.2s ease-out;
        }
        @keyframes slideDown {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
        .incoming-header {
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
            font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent);
            letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .incoming-body {
            font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.45; max-height: 120px; overflow-y: auto;
            word-break: break-word; user-select: text !important; -webkit-user-select: text !important;
            color: var(--text);
        }
        .incoming-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
        .incoming-btn {
            flex: 1; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 13px; border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--accent); background: var(--accent);
            color: #fff; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            text-align: center;
        }
        .incoming-btn.secondary {
            background: var(--panel); border-color: var(--panel-border); color: var(--text);
        }
        .incoming-btn.success { background: #00c853 !important; border-color: #00c853 !important; }

        main {
            flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
            padding: 12px 14px 4px 14px; gap: 8px; min-height: 0;
        }
        .textarea-wrapper { flex: 1; display: flex; min-height: 0; }

        /* Textarea: no transitions on focus to preserve native Android paste caret */
        textarea {
            flex: 1; width: 100%; background: var(--textarea-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--textarea-border); border-radius: 14px;
            color: var(--text); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.55; padding: 16px;
            outline: none; resize: none; font-family: inherit;
            user-select: text !important; -webkit-user-select: text !important;
            -webkit-appearance: none;
        }
        textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
        textarea::placeholder { color: var(--placeholder); font-size: 16px; }

        /* Balanced Utility Row */
        .utility-row {
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
            padding: 2px 2px; flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .tag-counter {
            font-size: 11px; font-family: monospace; color: var(--text-dim);
            background: var(--chip-bg); padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); font-weight: 600;
        }
        .chip-bar { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
        .chip {
            background: var(--chip-bg); border: 1px solid var(--chip-border);
            color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 11px; font-family: monospace;
            padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
            font-weight: 700;
        }
        .chip:active { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; }

        footer { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 14px 14px 14px; flex-shrink: 0; }
        button {
            border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 800;
            cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
        }
        .btn-clear {
            background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 13px; padding: 0 18px; height: 56px; min-width: 70px;
        }
        .btn-clear:active { background: rgba(125, 125, 125, 0.2); color: var(--text); }

        #send-btn {
            flex: 1; height: 56px; background: var(--accent); color: #fff;
            font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 14px var(--accent-glow);
            transition: transform 0.1s ease, background-color 0.15s ease;
        }
        #send-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }
        #send-btn.success { background: #00c853 !important; }

        /* History Drawer */
        #history-sheet {
            position: fixed; inset: 0; background: var(--history-bg);
            backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
            display: none; flex-direction: column; z-index: 100; padding: 18px;
        }
        #history-sheet.open { display: flex; }
        .history-top {
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px;
        }
        .history-list {
            flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;
        }
        .history-item {
            background: var(--history-item-bg); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow);
        }
        .history-meta {
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
            font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent);
        }
        .history-meta-right {
            font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); font-family: monospace;
        }
        .history-text {
            font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; color: var(--text); cursor: pointer;
            user-select: text !important; -webkit-user-select: text !important;
        }
        .history-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: flex-end; }
        .history-mini-btn {
            background: rgba(125, 125, 125, 0.1); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            color: var(--text); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer;
        }
        .history-mini-btn.delete { color: #dc2626; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="app-root">
        <header>
            <div class="brand">
                <div class="status-dot"></div>
                VoiceBridge
                <span class="version-tag">v1.0</span>
            </div>
            <div class="header-actions">
                <button class="btn-header" title="Reload" onclick="window.location.reload()">&#x21bb;</button>
                <button class="btn-header" onclick="openHistory()">HISTORY</button>
            </div>
        </header>

        <!-- Incoming from Mac (on phone) -->
        <div id="incoming-card">
            <div class="incoming-header">
                <span>Received from Mac</span>
                <span style="font-size:18px; cursor:pointer; padding:2px 8px;" onclick="closeIncoming()">&#x2715;</span>
            </div>
            <div class="incoming-body" id="incoming-text"></div>
            <div class="incoming-actions">
                <button class="incoming-btn" id="copy-btn" onclick="copyIncoming()">COPY TO CLIPBOARD</button>
                <button class="incoming-btn secondary" onclick="insertIncoming()">INSERT TO BOX</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <main>
            <div class="textarea-wrapper">
                <textarea id="input"></textarea>
            </div>

            <!-- Balanced Utility Row: Counter above Clear, chips on right for easy reach -->
            <div class="utility-row">
                <div class="tag-counter" id="counter">0w &bull; 0c</div>
                <div class="chip-bar">
                    <button class="chip" onclick="insertText('&bull; ')">+ Bullet</button>
                    <button class="chip" onclick="pasteFromPhoneClipboard()">📋 Paste</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </main>

        <footer>
            <button class="btn-clear" onclick="clearText()">CLEAR</button>
            <button id="send-btn" onpointerdown="handlePointerDown(event)" onclick="handleSend()">SEND TO MAC</button>
        </footer>
    </div>

    <div id="history-sheet">
        <div class="history-top">
            <div style="font-weight:800; letter-spacing:1px;">CLIPBOARD HISTORY</div>
            <div style="display:flex; gap:8px;">
                <button class="btn-header" style="color:#dc2626;" onclick="clearAllHistory()">CLEAR ALL</button>
                <button class="btn-header" onclick="closeHistory()">CLOSE</button>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="history-list" id="history-items"></div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const input = document.getElementById('input');
        const counter = document.getElementById('counter');
        const sendBtn = document.getElementById('send-btn');
        const incomingCard = document.getElementById('incoming-card');
        const incomingText = document.getElementById('incoming-text');
        const copyBtn = document.getElementById('copy-btn');
        const historySheet = document.getElementById('history-sheet');
        const historyList = document.getElementById('history-items');

        let lastSeenId = 0;
        let cachedHistory = [];

        const isMac = !/Android|iPhone|iPad|Mobile/i.test(navigator.userAgent);

        if (isMac) {
            sendBtn.innerText = "SEND TO PHONE";
            input.placeholder = "Type or paste on Mac to push over to your phone...";
        } else {
            sendBtn.innerText = "SEND TO MAC";
            input.placeholder = "Tap mic on Gboard to dictate...";
        }

        function handlePointerDown(e) {
            if (!isMac) {
                e.preventDefault(); // Prevents Gboard from closing on send
            }
        }

        // Automatic Light/Dark Theme Detection
        const themeQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
        function applyThemeMeta(e) {
            const meta = document.getElementById('meta-theme-color');
            if (meta) meta.setAttribute('content', e.matches ? '#070a0e' : '#f8fafc');
        }
        themeQuery.addEventListener('change', applyThemeMeta);
        applyThemeMeta(themeQuery);

        // WebAudio Sound Synthesis
        const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        function playChime(freq = 600, duration = 0.08) {
            try {
                if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
                const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
                osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 1.5, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, audioCtx.currentTime);
                gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                osc.start();
                osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        input.addEventListener('input', updateCount);

        function updateCount() {
            const val = input.value.trim();
            const chars = input.value.length;
            const words = val ? val.split(/\\s+/).length : 0;
            counter.innerHTML = `${words}w &bull; ${chars}c`;
        }

        function clearText() {
            input.value = '';
            updateCount();
            input.focus();
        }

        function insertText(str) {
            const start = input.selectionStart;
            const end = input.selectionEnd;
            input.value = input.value.substring(0, start) + str + input.value.substring(end);
            input.selectionStart = input.selectionEnd = start + str.length;
            updateCount();
        }

        function pasteFromPhoneClipboard() {
            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.readText) {
                navigator.clipboard.readText().then(text => {
                    if (text) insertText(text);
                }).catch(() => {
                    input.focus();
                });
            } else {
                input.focus();
            }
        }

        function handleSend() {
            const text = input.value;
            if (!text.trim()) return;

            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(30);
            playChime(isMac ? 680 : 540);

            sendBtn.classList.add('success');
            const originalText = sendBtn.innerText;

            if (isMac) {
                // Mac pushes to Phone (text stays in box)
                sendBtn.innerText = 'SENT TO PHONE!';
                fetch('/send-to-phone', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ text: text })
                }).then(() => {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        sendBtn.classList.remove('success');
                        sendBtn.innerText = originalText;
                    }, 1000);
                });
            } else {
                // Phone dictates to Mac cursor
                sendBtn.innerText = 'SENT!';
                fetch('/paste', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ text: text })
                }).then(() => {
                    input.value = '';
                    updateCount();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        sendBtn.classList.remove('success');
                        sendBtn.innerText = originalText;
                    }, 400);
                }).catch(() => {
                    sendBtn.classList.remove('success');
                    sendBtn.innerText = 'FAILED TO REACH MAC';
                    setTimeout(() => { sendBtn.innerText = originalText; }, 1500);
                });
            }
        }

        function pollSync() {
            fetch('/poll')
                .then(r => r.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (!data) return;
                    if (!isMac) {
                        const msg = data.phone_msg;
                        if (msg && msg.id > lastSeenId && msg.text) {
                            lastSeenId = msg.id;
                            showIncoming(msg.text);
                        }
                    }
                })
                .catch(() => {})
                .finally(() => {
                    setTimeout(pollSync, 1000);
                });
        }
        pollSync();

        function showIncoming(txt) {
            incomingText.innerText = txt;
            incomingCard.style.display = 'flex';
            copyBtn.innerText = 'COPY TO CLIPBOARD';
            copyBtn.classList.remove('success');
            playChime(720, 0.12);
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate([30, 40, 30]);
        }

        function closeIncoming() {
            incomingCard.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function copyIncoming() {
            const txt = incomingText.innerText;
            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(() => {
                    copyBtn.innerText = 'COPIED!';
                    copyBtn.classList.add('success');
                });
            }
        }

        function insertIncoming() {
            insertText(incomingText.innerText);
            closeIncoming();
        }

        function openHistory() {
            fetch('/history')
                .then(r => r.json())
                .then(items => {
                    cachedHistory = items || [];
                    renderHistory();
                    historySheet.classList.add('open');
                });
        }

        function closeHistory() {
            historySheet.classList.remove('open');
        }

        function renderHistory() {
            if (cachedHistory.length === 0) {
                historyList.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--text-dim); text-align:center; margin-top:40px;">No history yet.</div>';
                return;
            }

            historyList.innerHTML = cachedHistory.map((item, idx) => {
                const words = item.text.trim() ? item.text.trim().split(/\\s+/).length : 0;
                const chars = item.text.length;
                return `
                    <div class="history-item">
                        <div class="history-meta">
                            <span>FROM ${item.from.toUpperCase()} &bull; ${words}w ${chars}c</span>
                            <span class="history-meta-right">${item.time}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="history-text" onclick="loadFromHistory(${idx})">${escapeHtml(item.text)}</div>
                        <div class="history-actions">
                            <button class="history-mini-btn" onclick="copyHistoryItem(${idx}, this)">COPY</button>
                            <button class="history-mini-btn delete" onclick="deleteHistoryItem(${item.id})">DELETE</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }

        function escapeHtml(str) {
            return str.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
        }

        function loadFromHistory(idx) {
            if (cachedHistory[idx]) {
                input.value = cachedHistory[idx].text;
                updateCount();
                closeHistory();
                input.focus();
            }
        }

        function copyHistoryItem(idx, btn) {
            if (cachedHistory[idx]) {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(cachedHistory[idx].text).then(() => {
                    btn.innerText = 'COPIED!';
                    setTimeout(() => { btn.innerText = 'COPY'; }, 800);
                });
            }
        }

        function deleteHistoryItem(id) {
            fetch('/history/delete', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({ id: id })
            }).then(() => {
                cachedHistory = cachedHistory.filter(it => it.id !== id);
                renderHistory();
            });
        }

        function clearAllHistory() {
            fetch('/history/clear', { method: 'POST' }).then(() => {
                cachedHistory = [];
                renderHistory();
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
"""

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def send_no_cache_headers(self, content_type='text/html; charset=utf-8', status=200):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header('Content-type', content_type)
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate')
        self.send_header('Pragma', 'no-cache')
        self.send_header('Expires', '0')
        self.send_header('Connection', 'close')
        self.end_headers()

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path.startswith('/poll'):
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json')
            data = {
                "phone_msg": SERVER_STATE["phone_msg"],
                "mac_msg": SERVER_STATE["mac_msg"]
            }
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(data).encode('utf-8'))

        elif self.path == '/history':
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json')
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(SERVER_STATE["history"]).encode('utf-8'))

        else:
            self.send_no_cache_headers('text/html; charset=utf-8')
            self.wfile.write(HTML.encode('utf-8'))

    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8')) if length > 0 else {}

        if self.path == '/paste':
            text = body.get('text', '')
            if text:
                p = subprocess.Popen(['pbcopy'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
                p.communicate(text.encode('utf-8'))

                subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "v" using command down'])

                cur_id = int(time.time() * 1000)
                now_str = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                SERVER_STATE["mac_msg"] = {"id": cur_id, "text": text, "time": now_str}
                SERVER_STATE["history"].insert(0, {"id": cur_id, "text": text, "from": "phone", "time": now_str})
                save_history(SERVER_STATE["history"])

            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(b'{"status":"ok"}')

        elif self.path == '/send-to-phone':
            text = body.get('text', '')
            if text:
                cur_id = int(time.time() * 1000)
                now_str = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                SERVER_STATE["phone_msg"] = {"id": cur_id, "text": text, "time": now_str}
                SERVER_STATE["history"].insert(0, {"id": cur_id, "text": text, "from": "mac", "time": now_str})
                save_history(SERVER_STATE["history"])

            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"status": "ok", "id": cur_id}).encode('utf-8'))

        elif self.path == '/history/delete':
            msg_id = body.get('id')
            SERVER_STATE["history"] = [it for it in SERVER_STATE["history"] if it.get("id") != msg_id]
            save_history(SERVER_STATE["history"])
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(b'{"status":"ok"}')

        elif self.path == '/history/clear':
            SERVER_STATE["history"] = []
            save_history(SERVER_STATE["history"])
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(b'{"status":"ok"}')

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        return

if __name__ == '__main__':
    port = 5050
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    try:
        s.connect(('8.8.8.8', 80))
        local_ip = s.getsockname()[0]
    except Exception:
        local_ip = 'localhost'
    finally:
        s.close()

    print(f"VoiceBridge v1.0 running at: http://{local_ip}:{port}")
    ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', port), Handler).serve_forever()
```

# VoiceBridge v1.0

A high-speed, zero-dependency wireless dictation and clipboard bridge connecting your Android phone (Pixel 7 / Gboard / Rambler) directly to your Mac.

---

## What It Does
- **Phone $\to$ Mac Instant Injection**: Tap the mic on your phone's keyboard, dictate a prompt, email, or code block, and tap **SEND TO MAC**. The entire text block pastes instantly into your Mac's active window (`pbcopy` + simulated `Cmd + V`).
- **Mac $\to$ Phone Wireless Clipboard**: Type or paste any text on your Mac, click **SEND TO PHONE**, and a notification card appears instantly on your phone with a one-tap **COPY TO CLIPBOARD** button.
- **Persistent Universal History**: Stores past messages sent both ways in a local `history.json` file. Features individual copy/delete controls and a "Clear All" action.
- **Zero Cloud / Zero Dependencies**: Operates 100% locally over your home Wi-Fi network using Python's standard library. No third-party packages, no npm, no accounts, and no data leaves your local network.

---

## Directory & File Setup

VoiceBridge lives directly in your project folder:

```text
/Users/ethanfreeman/Downloads/Ai Studio Apps/VoiceBridge/
├── voicebridge.py      # The self-contained Python server and web client
└── README.md           # Documentation
```

Runtime storage:

```
~/.voicebridge/
└── history.json        # Persistent clipboard history (auto-created)
```

## How to Start or Reload

Whenever you want to start VoiceBridge or apply code updates after editing voicebridge.py, run this single command in Terminal:

```
kill -9 $(lsof -ti :5050) 2>/dev/null; nohup python3 "/Users/ethanfreeman/Downloads/Ai Studio Apps/VoiceBridge/voicebridge.py" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
```

This command:
1. Frees port 5050.Starts the server directly from your folder in the background.Decouples the process so you can close Terminal immediately.

## How to Use

### 1. On Your Phone (Pixel 7)

1. Ensure your phone is connected to the same Wi-Fi as your Mac.Open Chrome or Brave and go to:

```
http://192.168.0.102:5050
```

(Tip: Tap **Add to Home Screen** in your browser to run it full-screen like a native app).Tap the text area, use your modded Gboard / Rambler mic to dictate, and tap **SEND TO MAC**.The text immediately pastes into whatever text field has focus on your Mac.

### 2. On Your Mac

1. Open Chrome and go to:

```
http://localhost:5050
```

Type or paste any text you want to transfer to your phone and click **SEND TO PHONE**.Look at your phone: an incoming card will pop up with a **COPY TO CLIPBOARD** button.

## UI Layout & Features

* **Header**: Status dot (green = live, amber = disconnected), app title, v1.0 badge, quick reload (⟳), and history drawer button.**Utility Row**:**Left**: Live word and character counter (0w • 0c) positioned above the Clear button.**Right**: Thumb-reachable action chips (+ Bullet and 📋 Paste).**Footer**: High-contrast, tactile CLEAR and SEND TO MAC / SEND TO PHONE buttons.**Mobile Interaction**:Tapping send does **not** close or bounce Gboard.Native Android text selection (double-tap/drag caret) works normally.Pull-down to refresh is natively supported.Automatic system Light and Dark theme adaptation.

## Troubleshooting

* **"Failed to Reach Mac" on Phone**:Verify that your Mac and phone are on the exact same Wi-Fi network.Check that your Mac's local IP is still 192.168.0.102. (Option-click the Wi-Fi icon on your Mac menu bar to check).**Text does not paste into Mac app**:Make sure macOS Accessibility permissions are granted to Terminal / Python under **System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility**.**Port 5050 is busy**:Run the reload command above. It automatically kills any process holding port 5050.

---

**Model:**

Model 5:30 AMYes, you are completely right. Hardcoding your specific local IP, username, and phone model defeats the purpose of documentation.

VoiceBridge is fundamentally **device-agnostic on the mobile side**: any device with a modern web browser and a keyboard with speech-to-text—whether it's an iPhone using Apple Dictation, an Android phone using Gboard, or an iPad—can connect, dictate, and bridge text to the Mac. The only platform requirement is on the receiving end (macOS), because it uses native AppleScript and pbcopy to inject keystrokes.

Here is the clean, comprehensive, and fully generalized README.md:

```
# VoiceBridge v1.0

A lightweight, zero-dependency local network bridge that turns any smartphone into an instantaneous voice-dictation and bidirectional clipboard controller for macOS.

---

## Overview

VoiceBridge allows you to dictate text using your smartphone's speech-to-text engine (Gboard, Apple Dictation, etc.) and have it instantly injected into whatever window or text field is currently active on your Mac. It also allows pushing text from your Mac back to your phone with a single click.

Unlike cloud-based tools or third-party apps:
- **Zero External Dependencies**: Runs entirely on Python 3 standard library tools built into macOS. No `pip install`, no Node.js, and no external binaries.
- **100% Private & Local**: Operates strictly within your local Wi-Fi network. No audio or text data ever leaves your machines.
- **True Instant Injection**: Instead of slow simulated typing, it uses native macOS clipboard injection (`pbcopy` + AppleScript `Cmd+V`) to paste entire multi-paragraph blocks in under a millisecond.
- **Platform Agnostic Client**: Works on any mobile device (Android, iOS) with a web browser.

---

## How It Works
```

┌─────────────────────────┐               Local Wi-Fi                ┌──────────────────────────┐│      Mobile Device      │  ─────────── HTTP POST /paste ─────────>  │        Mac Host          ││ (Any Phone / Tablet)    │                                          │  (Python ThreadingServer)││                         │  <─────── HTTP GET /poll (Sync) ──────── │                          ││ • Speech-to-Text Input  │                                          │  1. Ingests payload      ││ • WebAudio Sound Engine │  <─────── HTTP POST /send-to-phone ───── │  2. Copies to pbcopy   ││ • Touch-Docked UI       │                                          │  3. Simulates Cmd + V  │└─────────────────────────┘                                          └──────────────────────────┘

```
1. **Mac Host**: Runs a lightweight, multi-threaded Python server (`voicebridge.py`) listening on port `5050`.
2. **Mobile Client**: Serves a clean, mobile-optimized web app with a responsive textarea, persistent clipboard history, and touch-optimized controls.
3. **Injection Pipeline**: When text is submitted from the phone, the server writes the payload directly to the macOS clipboard via `pbcopy` and signals `System Events` to fire `Cmd + V` into whatever window has focus.

---

## Prerequisites

- **Mac Host**: macOS 10.14 (Mojave) or newer with Python 3.
- **Mobile Device**: Any smartphone or tablet connected to the same Wi-Fi network.
- **macOS Permissions**: Terminal (or your terminal emulator) must be granted **Accessibility** permissions to allow keystroke simulation.

---

## Initial Setup (One-Time)

### 1. Grant Accessibility Permissions on Mac
To allow the script to execute `Cmd + V` into your active window:
1. Open **System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility**.
2. Ensure your terminal application (e.g., **Terminal**, **iTerm2**, or your code editor) is toggled **ON**.

### 2. File Placement
Place `voicebridge.py` in your preferred directory (for example, `~/VoiceBridge/voicebridge.py`).

---

## Running VoiceBridge

### Start in Background / Reload Command
To launch VoiceBridge in the background—or to reload it after making edits to the code—run this command in Terminal (replace the path with the actual location of your file):

```bash
kill -9 $(lsof -ti :5050) 2>/dev/null; nohup python3 "$HOME/path/to/VoiceBridge/voicebridge.py" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
```

This command:
1. Terminates any previous process currently occupying port 5050.Launches voicebridge.py in the background with nohup.Decouples the process so you can safely close the Terminal window.

## Connecting Your Phone

1. **Find your Mac's local IP address**:Hold the Option key and click the **Wi-Fi icon** in your Mac's top menu bar.Look for **IP Address** (typically something like 192.168.1.X or 192.168.0.X).Alternatively, run in Terminal:

```
ipconfig getifaddr en0
```

**Open the Web App on Your Phone**:Open Chrome, Safari, or Brave on your phone.Navigate to:

```
http://<YOUR-MAC-IP>:5050
```

(Example: http://192.168.1.45:5050)**Install as a PWA / Web App (Recommended)**:**Android (Chrome/Brave)**: Tap the three dots menu > **Add to Home Screen** / **Install App**.**iOS (Safari)**: Tap the Share button > **Add to Home Screen**.This allows VoiceBridge to open full-screen without browser URL bars, behaving like a native application.

## Usage & Workflows

### Phone         →\to→
       Mac (Dictation)

1. On your Mac, place your text cursor inside any application (chat window, code editor, email client, document).On your phone, open VoiceBridge.Tap the text area and activate your keyboard's microphone (e.g., Gboard voice typing, Apple Dictation).When finished speaking, tap **SEND TO MAC**.The text will instantly paste into your active Mac window.

### Mac         →\to→
       Phone (Wireless Clipboard)

1. Open http://localhost:5050 on your Mac browser. The interface will automatically recognize it is running on the host machine.Type or paste any text or links into the box and click **SEND TO PHONE**.On your phone, an incoming card will appear immediately with:**COPY TO CLIPBOARD**: Copies the received text straight into your mobile clipboard.**INSERT TO BOX**: Appends the text into the phone's text area.

## Features

* **Device-Aware Interface**: Automatically configures the UI depending on whether it is accessed from the Mac host (SEND TO PHONE) or a mobile device (SEND TO MAC).**Zero Keyboard Bounce**: Mobile touch handlers prevent the virtual keyboard from blurring/collapsing when tapping Send, allowing uninterrupted dictation sessions.**Persistent Universal History**: Saves up to 50 past transmissions to ~/.voicebridge/history.json. Each entry includes timestamps, source tags (FROM MAC / FROM PHONE), word/character counts, and individual copy/delete controls.**Adaptive System Theming**: Automatically synchronizes with system-level Light and Dark modes (prefers-color-scheme) with custom high-contrast palettes.**Local WebAudio Feedback**: Synthesizes soft status chimes directly via the browser's WebAudio API without loading external sound files.

## Troubleshooting

### "This site can't be reached" on mobile

1. Ensure both your Mac and your mobile device are connected to the exact same Wi-Fi network.Verify that your router does not have "Client Isolation" or "Guest Mode" enabled, which prevents local devices from communicating.Check if the macOS Application Firewall is blocking incoming connections:Go to **System Settings > Network > Firewall**. If enabled, ensure Python is allowed to accept incoming connections.

### Text does not paste on the Mac

1. Ensure the window on your Mac is actively focused and has a blinking text cursor.Verify Accessibility permissions:Go to **System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility**.Remove and re-add your Terminal application if you recently upgraded macOS.

### Address already in use (Errno 48)

A previous instance is still holding port 5050. Run:

```
kill -9 $(lsof -ti :5050)
```

Then start the server again.

Simulates Cmd + V  │└─────────────────────────┘                                          └──────────────────────────┘

```
1. **Mac Host**: Runs a lightweight, multi-threaded Python server (`voicebridge.py`) listening on port `5050`.

3. **Injection Pipeline**: When text is submitted from the phone, the server writes the payload directly to the macOS clipboard via `pbcopy` and signals `System Events` to fire `Cmd + V` into whatever window has focus.

---

## Prerequisites

- **Mac Host**: macOS 10.14 (Mojave) or newer with Python 3.
- **Mobile Device**: Any smartphone or tablet connected to the same Wi-Fi network.

## Initial Setup (One-Time)

### 1. Grant Accessibility Permissions on Mac
To allow the script to execute `Cmd + V` into your active window:
1. Open **System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility**.
2. Ensure your terminal application (e.g., **Terminal**, **iTerm2**, or your code editor) is toggled **ON**.

### 2. Recommended File Location
Place `voicebridge.py` in a dedicated directory inside your home folder, for example:
```text
~/VoiceBridge/voicebridge.py
```

**Important macOS Security Note**: Do **not** place the file inside ~/Downloads, ~/Documents, or ~/Desktop if you plan to run it as an automatic background service. macOS privacy sandbox rules (TCC) silently block background daemons from reading files inside those three specific folders. Using ~/VoiceBridge/ or any other user folder avoids this entirely.

## Running VoiceBridge

You have two choices for running VoiceBridge: **Manual/On-Demand** or **Automatic Background Service (Login Item)**.

### Option A: Running as an Automatic Background Service (Recommended)

This makes VoiceBridge start silently in the background every time your Mac turns on. It requires zero open terminal windows, automatically restarts if killed, and appears in **System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions**.

1. Create the LaunchAgent configuration:

```
python3 -c "import plistlib, os; path = os.path.expanduser('~/VoiceBridge/voicebridge.py'); data = {'Label': 'com.user.voicebridge', 'ProgramArguments': ['/usr/bin/python3', path], 'RunAtLoad': True, 'KeepAlive': True}; plistlib.dump(data, open(os.path.expanduser('~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.voicebridge.plist'), 'wb'))"
```

(Make sure ~/VoiceBridge/voicebridge.py matches where your file is located).Register and start the background service:

```
launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.voicebridge.plist
```

Verify it is running:

```
launchctl list | grep voicebridge
```

(A line showing a process number and 0 confirms it is running).
**Managing the Background Service:**
* **To Stop / Disable**:

```
launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.user.voicebridge.plist
```

**To Restart (after editing code)**:

```
kill -9 $(lsof -ti :5050)
```

(Because KeepAlive is enabled, killing the process forces macOS to immediately relaunch it with your updated code).

### Option B: Manual / On-Demand Execution

If you prefer running VoiceBridge only when needed without registering a persistent system service:

```
kill -9 $(lsof -ti :5050) 2>/dev/null; nohup python3 "$HOME/VoiceBridge/voicebridge.py" >/dev/null 2>&1 &
```

This frees port 5050, launches the server in the background, and lets you close the Terminal window.

```

http://<YOUR-MAC-IP>:5050

import os

import json
import time
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler

HISTORY_FILE = os.path.expanduser("~/.voicebridge/history.json")

def load_history():
    try:
        if os.path.exists(HISTORY_FILE):
            with open(HISTORY_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return []

def save_history(history):
    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(HISTORY_FILE), exist_ok=True)
        with open(HISTORY_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(history[:50], f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception:
        pass

    "mac_msg": {"id": 0, "text": "", "time": ""},
    "history": load_history()
}

            color: #ef4444;
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.2);
        }
        .btn-clear:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

        #send-btn {
            flex: 1; height: 56px; background: var(--accent); color: #fff;
            font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 14px var(--accent-glow);
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }
        #send-btn:hover {
            background: var(--accent-hover);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-glow);
            filter: brightness(1.06);
        }
        #send-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }
        #send-btn.success { background: #00c853 !important; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 200, 83, 0.5) !important; }

        /* Unified History Drawer */
        #history-sheet {
            position: absolute; top: 61px; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            background: var(--history-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            display: none; flex-direction: column; z-index: 110; padding: 18px;
            animation: fadeIn 0.15s ease-out;
        }
        @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
        #history-sheet.open { display: flex; }
        .history-title {
            font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1px; font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-dim); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 12px;
        }
        .history-list {
            flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;
            padding-bottom: 20px;
        }
        .history-item {
            background: var(--history-item-bg); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow); transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
        }
        .history-item:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
        .history-meta {
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
            font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent);
        }
        .history-meta-right {
            font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); font-family: monospace;
        }
        .history-text {
            font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--text); cursor: pointer;
            user-select: text !important; -webkit-user-select: text !important;
        }
        .history-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: flex-end; }
        
        /* Action buttons in history card */
        .history-mini-btn {
            background: rgba(125, 125, 125, 0.1); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            color: var(--text); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.15s ease;
        }
        .history-mini-btn:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-glow); border-color: var(--accent); }
        .history-mini-btn:active { transform: scale(0.96); }
        .history-mini-btn.copy {
            background: var(--accent); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent);
        }
        .history-mini-btn.copy.success { background: #00c853 !important; border-color: #00c853 !important; }
        .history-mini-btn.delete { color: var(--text-dim); }
        .history-mini-btn.delete:hover { border-color: #dc2626; color: #dc2626; }

        /* Clear All Button at bottom of history */
        .clear-all-row {
            margin-top: 10px; display: flex; justify-content: center; padding-bottom: 25px;
        }
        .btn-clear-all {
            background: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.08); border: 1px solid rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.25);
            color: #ef4444; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; padding: 10px 24px;
            border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: 0.5px; transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }
        .btn-clear-all:hover {
            background: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.16);
            border-color: #ef4444;
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.3);
        }
        .btn-clear-all:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="app-root">
        <header>
            <div class="brand">
                <div class="status-dot"></div>
                VoiceBridge
                <span class="version-tag">v1.0</span>
            </div>
            <div class="header-actions">
                <button class="icon-btn" title="Reload" onclick="window.location.reload()">
                    <!-- Crisp Vector Reload SVG -->
                    <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
                        <path d="M21.5 2v6h-6M21.34 15.57a10 10 0 1 1-.57-8.38l5.67-5.67"/>
                    </svg>
                </button>
                <!-- Unified Dynamic Button (HISTORY <-> CLOSE) -->
                <button class="btn-header" id="history-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleHistory()">HISTORY</button>
            </div>
        </header>

        <!-- Incoming from Mac (on phone) -->
        <div id="incoming-card">
            <div class="incoming-header">
                <span>Received from Mac</span>
                <span style="font-size:18px; cursor:pointer; padding:2px 8px;" onclick="closeIncoming()">&#x2715;</span>
            </div>
            <div class="incoming-body" id="incoming-text"></div>
            <div class="incoming-actions">
                <button class="incoming-btn" id="copy-btn" onclick="copyIncoming()">COPY TO CLIPBOARD</button>
                <button class="incoming-btn secondary" onclick="insertIncoming()">INSERT TO BOX</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <main>
            <div class="textarea-wrapper">
                <textarea id="input"></textarea>
            </div>

            <!-- Balanced Utility Row: Counter above Clear, chips on right for easy reach -->
            <div class="utility-row">
                <div class="tag-counter" id="counter">0w &bull; 0c</div>
                <div class="chip-bar">
                    <button class="chip" onclick="insertText('&bull; ')">+ Bullet</button>
                    <button class="chip" onclick="pasteFromPhoneClipboard()">📋 Paste</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </main>

        <footer>
            <button class="btn-clear" onclick="clearText()">CLEAR</button>
            <button id="send-btn" onpointerdown="handlePointerDown(event)" onclick="handleSend()">SEND TO MAC</button>
        </footer>

        <!-- Unified History Drawer below header -->
        <div id="history-sheet">
            <div class="history-title">CLIPBOARD HISTORY</div>
            <div class="history-list" id="history-items"></div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        const input = document.getElementById('input');
        const counter = document.getElementById('counter');
        const sendBtn = document.getElementById('send-btn');
        const incomingCard = document.getElementById('incoming-card');
        const incomingText = document.getElementById('incoming-text');
        const copyBtn = document.getElementById('copy-btn');
        const historySheet = document.getElementById('history-sheet');
        const historyList = document.getElementById('history-items');
        const historyToggleBtn = document.getElementById('history-toggle-btn');

        let lastSeenId = 0;
        let cachedHistory = [];
        let isHistoryOpen = false;

        const isMac = !/Android|iPhone|iPad|Mobile/i.test(navigator.userAgent);

        if (isMac) {
            sendBtn.innerText = "SEND TO PHONE";
            input.placeholder = "Type or paste on Mac to push over to your phone...";
        } else {
            sendBtn.innerText = "SEND TO MAC";
            input.placeholder = "Tap mic on Gboard to dictate...";
        }

        function handlePointerDown(e) {
            if (!isMac) {
                e.preventDefault(); // Prevents Gboard from closing on send
            }
        }

        // Automatic Light/Dark Theme Detection
        const themeQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
        function applyThemeMeta(e) {
            const meta = document.getElementById('meta-theme-color');
            if (meta) meta.setAttribute('content', e.matches ? '#070a0e' : '#f8fafc');
        }
        themeQuery.addEventListener('change', applyThemeMeta);
        applyThemeMeta(themeQuery);

        // WebAudio Sound Synthesis
        const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        function playChime(freq = 600, duration = 0.08) {
            try {
                if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
                const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
                osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 1.5, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, audioCtx.currentTime);
                gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                osc.start();
                osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        input.addEventListener('input', updateCount);

        function updateCount() {
            const val = input.value.trim();
            const chars = input.value.length;
            const words = val ? val.split(/\\s+/).length : 0;
            counter.innerHTML = `${words}w &bull; ${chars}c`;
        }

        function clearText() {
            input.value = '';
            updateCount();
            input.focus();
        }

        function insertText(str) {
            const start = input.selectionStart;
            const end = input.selectionEnd;
            input.value = input.value.substring(0, start) + str + input.value.substring(end);
            input.selectionStart = input.selectionEnd = start + str.length;
            updateCount();
        }

        function pasteFromPhoneClipboard() {
            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.readText) {
                navigator.clipboard.readText().then(text => {
                    if (text) insertText(text);
                }).catch(() => {
                    input.focus();
                });
            } else {
                input.focus();
            }
        }

        function handleSend() {
            const text = input.value;
            if (!text.trim()) return;

            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(30);
            playChime(isMac ? 680 : 540);

            sendBtn.classList.add('success');
            const originalText = sendBtn.innerText;

            if (isMac) {
                // Mac pushes to Phone (text remains in box)
                sendBtn.innerText = 'SENT TO PHONE!';
                fetch('/send-to-phone', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ text: text })
                }).then(() => {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        sendBtn.classList.remove('success');
                        sendBtn.innerText = originalText;
                    }, 1000);
                });
            } else {
                // Phone dictates to Mac cursor
                sendBtn.innerText = 'SENT!';
                fetch('/paste', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ text: text })
                }).then(() => {
                    input.value = '';
                    updateCount();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        sendBtn.classList.remove('success');
                        sendBtn.innerText = originalText;
                    }, 400);
                }).catch(() => {
                    sendBtn.classList.remove('success');
                    sendBtn.innerText = 'FAILED TO REACH MAC';
                    setTimeout(() => { sendBtn.innerText = originalText; }, 1500);
                });
            }
        }

        function pollSync() {
            fetch('/poll')
                .then(r => r.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (!data) return;
                    if (!isMac) {
                        const msg = data.phone_msg;
                        if (msg && msg.id > lastSeenId && msg.text) {
                            lastSeenId = msg.id;
                            showIncoming(msg.text);
                        }
                    }
                })
                .catch(() => {})
                .finally(() => {
                    setTimeout(pollSync, 1000);
                });
        }
        pollSync();

        function showIncoming(txt) {
            incomingText.innerText = txt;
            incomingCard.style.display = 'flex';
            copyBtn.innerText = 'COPY TO CLIPBOARD';
            copyBtn.classList.remove('success');
            playChime(720, 0.12);
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate([30, 40, 30]);
        }

        function closeIncoming() {
            incomingCard.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function copyIncoming() {
            const txt = incomingText.innerText;
            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(() => {
                    copyBtn.innerText = 'COPIED!';
                    copyBtn.classList.add('success');
                });
            }
        }

        function insertIncoming() {
            insertText(incomingText.innerText);
            closeIncoming();
        }

        // Unified Dynamic History Toggle (never moves position)
        function toggleHistory() {
            isHistoryOpen = !isHistoryOpen;
            if (isHistoryOpen) {
                historyToggleBtn.innerText = 'CLOSE';
                historyToggleBtn.classList.add('active-close');
                fetch('/history')
                    .then(r => r.json())
                    .then(items => {
                        cachedHistory = items || [];
                        renderHistory();
                        historySheet.classList.add('open');
                    });
            } else {
                historyToggleBtn.innerText = 'HISTORY';
                historyToggleBtn.classList.remove('active-close');
                historySheet.classList.remove('open');
            }
        }

        function renderHistory() {
            if (cachedHistory.length === 0) {
                historyList.innerHTML = '<div style="color:var(--text-dim); text-align:center; margin-top:40px; font-size:13px;">No history yet.</div>';
                return;
            }

            let html = cachedHistory.map((item, idx) => {
                const words = item.text.trim() ? item.text.trim().split(/\\s+/).length : 0;
                const chars = item.text.length;
                return `
                    <div class="history-item">
                        <div class="history-meta">
                            <span>FROM ${item.from.toUpperCase()} &bull; ${words}w ${chars}c</span>
                            <span class="history-meta-right">${item.time}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div class="history-text" onclick="loadFromHistory(${idx})">${escapeHtml(item.text)}</div>
                        <div class="history-actions">
                            <button class="history-mini-btn delete" onclick="deleteHistoryItem(${item.id})">DELETE</button>
                            <button class="history-mini-btn copy" onclick="copyHistoryItem(${idx}, this)">COPY</button>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');

            // Clean Clear All Button at bottom of history items
            html += `
                <div class="clear-all-row">
                    <button class="btn-clear-all" onclick="clearAllHistory()">CLEAR ALL HISTORY</button>
                </div>
            `;

            historyList.innerHTML = html;
        }

        function escapeHtml(str) {
            return str.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
        }

        function loadFromHistory(idx) {
            if (cachedHistory[idx]) {
                input.value = cachedHistory[idx].text;
                updateCount();
                toggleHistory();
                input.focus();
            }
        }

        function copyHistoryItem(idx, btn) {
            if (cachedHistory[idx]) {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(cachedHistory[idx].text).then(() => {
                    btn.innerText = 'COPIED!';
                    btn.classList.add('success');
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        btn.innerText = 'COPY';
                        btn.classList.remove('success');
                    }, 800);
                });
            }
        }

        function deleteHistoryItem(id) {
            fetch('/history/delete', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({ id: id })
            }).then(() => {
                cachedHistory = cachedHistory.filter(it => it.id !== id);
                renderHistory();
            });
        }

        function clearAllHistory() {
            fetch('/history/clear', { method: 'POST' }).then(() => {
                cachedHistory = [];
                renderHistory();
            });
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
"""

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def send_no_cache_headers(self, content_type='text/html; charset=utf-8', status=200):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header('Content-type', content_type)
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate')
        self.send_header('Pragma', 'no-cache')
        self.send_header('Expires', '0')
        self.send_header('Connection', 'close')
        self.end_headers()

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path.startswith('/poll'):
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json')
            data = {
                "phone_msg": SERVER_STATE["phone_msg"],
                "mac_msg": SERVER_STATE["mac_msg"]
            }
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(data).encode('utf-8'))

        elif self.path == '/history':
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json')
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(SERVER_STATE["history"]).encode('utf-8'))

        else:
            self.send_no_cache_headers('text/html; charset=utf-8')
            self.wfile.write(HTML.encode('utf-8'))

    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8')) if length > 0 else {}

        if self.path == '/paste':
            text = body.get('text', '')
            if text:
                p = subprocess.Popen(['pbcopy'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
                p.communicate(text.encode('utf-8'))

                subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "v" using command down'])

                cur_id = int(time.time() * 1000)
                now_str = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                SERVER_STATE["mac_msg"] = {"id": cur_id, "text": text, "time": now_str}
                SERVER_STATE["history"].insert(0, {"id": cur_id, "text": text, "from": "phone", "time": now_str})
                save_history(SERVER_STATE["history"])

            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(b'{"status":"ok"}')

        elif self.path == '/send-to-phone':
            text = body.get('text', '')
            if text:
                cur_id = int(time.time() * 1000)
                now_str = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                SERVER_STATE["phone_msg"] = {"id": cur_id, "text": text, "time": now_str}
                SERVER_STATE["history"].insert(0, {"id": cur_id, "text": text, "from": "mac", "time": now_str})
                save_history(SERVER_STATE["history"])

            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"status": "ok", "id": cur_id}).encode('utf-8'))

        elif self.path == '/history/delete':
            msg_id = body.get('id')
            SERVER_STATE["history"] = [it for it in SERVER_STATE["history"] if it.get("id") != msg_id]
            save_history(SERVER_STATE["history"])
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(b'{"status":"ok"}')

        elif self.path == '/history/clear':
            SERVER_STATE["history"] = []
            save_history(SERVER_STATE["history"])
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(b'{"status":"ok"}')

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        return

if __name__ == '__main__':
    port = 5050
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    try:
        s.connect(('8.8.8.8', 80))
        local_ip = s.getsockname()[0]
    except Exception:
        local_ip = 'localhost'
    finally:
        s.close()

    print(f"VoiceBridge live: http://{local_ip}:{port}")
    ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', port), Handler).serve_forever()
```

Kept the larger, touch-friendly 36×36px container with an 18px font size so it renders cleanly and prominently.**Delete on Left, Copy on Right**: In each history card, DELETE is now anchored on the far left (matching the destructive CLEAR button layout on the left), and COPY is on the far right. Misclicking is now physically impossible.**Distinct Light & Dark Hover Feedback**: Clear buttons now show a crisp red warning tint on hover in both themes, and secondary/chip buttons have clear border and contrast shifts.

import os
import subprocess
import socket
import json
import time
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler

HISTORY_FILE = os.path.expanduser("~/.voicebridge/history.json")

def load_history():
    try:
        if os.path.exists(HISTORY_FILE):
            with open(HISTORY_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return []

def save_history(history):
    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(HISTORY_FILE), exist_ok=True)
        with open(HISTORY_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(history[:50], f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception:
        pass

SERVER_STATE = {
    "phone_msg": {"id": 0, "text": "", "time": ""},
    "mac_msg": {"id": 0, "text": "", "time": ""},
    "history": load_history()
}
