### The Five Adjustments:

1. **Restored the Buttons on the Cards**:**On Mobile**: Prominent **COPY** anchored on the right, subtle **DELETE** on the far left. The Archive button is **never shown** on mobile (swiping right handles archive).**On Desktop**: Actions fade in on hover. The left side has **DELETE** on the outer edge with **ARCHIVE** right beside it; **COPY** remains anchored on the far right.**Smooth Slide & Accordion Collapse (No More Snapping)**:Fixed the clunky swipe physics. When a card is dismissed, it smoothly slides off-screen, and the card wrapper's height shrinks to zero before the item is removed from data—making the list below it glide up smoothly.**Symmetrical Navigation & Top Export**:**Main History**: Bottom-right has **ARCHIVE (N) →**.**Archive View**: Bottom-right flips to **← BACK**.**Export Button**: Placed at the top-right of the Archive screen.**Clear Buttons**: Bottom-left clears only the active view (CLEAR HISTORY or CLEAR ARCHIVE).**Removed the Mobile Paste Chip**: Removed completely since plain HTTP blocks programmatic reading and native long-press handles it. Only + Bullet remains in the chip bar.

### Part 1: The File (voicebridge.py)

Replace the contents of /Users/ethanfreeman/Downloads/Ai Studio Apps/VoiceBridge/voicebridge.py:

```
import os
import subprocess
import socket
import json
import time
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler

HISTORY_FILE = os.path.expanduser("~/.voicebridge/history.json")

def load_data():
    default_data = {"history": [], "archive": []}
    try:
        if os.path.exists(HISTORY_FILE):
            with open(HISTORY_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                d = json.load(f)
                if isinstance(d, list):
                    return {"history": d, "archive": []}
                return d
    except Exception:
        pass
    return default_data

def save_data(data):
    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(HISTORY_FILE), exist_ok=True)
        with open(HISTORY_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump({
                "history": data.get("history", [])[:60],
                "archive": data.get("archive", [])[:100]
            }, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception:
        pass

DATA_STORE = load_data()

SERVER_STATE = {
    "phone_msg": {"id": 0, "text": "", "time": ""},
    "mac_msg": {"id": 0, "text": "", "time": ""},
    "history": DATA_STORE.get("history", []),
    "archive": DATA_STORE.get("archive", [])
}

HTML = """<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, interactive-widget=resizes-content">
    <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#f8fafc" id="meta-theme-color">
    <title>VoiceBridge v1.0</title>
    <style>
        /* Light Theme */
        :root {
            --bg: #f8fafc;
            --panel: #ffffff;
            --panel-border: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.09);
            --textarea-bg: #f1f5f9;
            --textarea-border: #cbd5e1;
            --accent: #1a73e8;
            --accent-hover: #1557b0;
            --accent-glow: rgba(26, 115, 232, 0.25);
            --accent-green: #0f9d58;
            --text: #0f172a;
            --text-dim: #64748b;
            --placeholder: #94a3b8;
            --card-bg: #e8f0fe;
            --card-border: #b3d7ff;
            --chip-bg: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
            --chip-border: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            --chip-hover-bg: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.09);
            --clear-hover-bg: #fee2e2;
            --clear-hover-border: #ef4444;
            --clear-hover-text: #b91c1c;
            --history-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98);
            --history-item-bg: #ffffff;
            --shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
        }

        /* Dark Theme */
        @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
            :root {
                --bg: #070a0e;
                --panel: #0d141e;
                --panel-border: rgba(51, 204, 255, 0.2);
                --textarea-bg: #0a0f16;
                --textarea-border: rgba(51, 204, 255, 0.2);
                --accent: #0099ff;
                --accent-hover: #0080d5;
                --accent-glow: rgba(0, 153, 255, 0.4);
                --accent-green: #00ffaa;
                --text: #e6f0fa;
                --text-dim: #557799;
                --placeholder: #335577;
                --card-bg: rgba(0, 153, 255, 0.12);
                --card-border: rgba(0, 153, 255, 0.5);
                --chip-bg: rgba(10, 20, 30, 0.6);
                --chip-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
                --chip-hover-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
                --clear-hover-bg: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.2);
                --clear-hover-border: #ef4444;
                --clear-hover-text: #f87171;
                --history-bg: rgba(7, 10, 14, 0.98);
                --history-item-bg: #0d141e;
                --shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            }
        }

        * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
        html, body {
            width: 100%; height: 100%; height: 100dvh;
            background: var(--bg); color: var(--text);
            font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif;
            overscroll-behavior-y: auto !important;
            overflow-y: auto;
            transition: background-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease;
        }

        #app-root { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 100%; height: 100%; position: relative; }

        header {
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
            padding: 12px 18px; background: var(--panel);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--panel-border); flex-shrink: 0;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow); z-index: 120;
        }
        .brand {
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
            font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1.5px; text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .status-dot {
            width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--accent-green); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-green);
        }
        .version-tag {
            font-size: 10px; color: var(--accent); font-weight: 800;
            background: var(--chip-bg); padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 4px;
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .header-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }

        .icon-btn {
            background: var(--chip-bg); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            color: var(--text); width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px;
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }
        .icon-btn:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-glow);
            border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent);
            background: var(--chip-hover-bg);
        }
        .icon-btn:active { transform: scale(0.95); }

        .btn-header {
            background: var(--chip-bg); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            color: var(--text); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            height: 36px; width: 88px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer;
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            transition: all 0.2s ease; text-align: center;
        }
        .btn-header:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-glow);
            border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--chip-hover-bg);
        }
        .btn-header:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
        .btn-header.active-close {
            background: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.12);
            border-color: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.4);
            color: #ef4444;
        }

        /* Incoming Card */
        #incoming-card {
            display: none; margin: 12px 14px 0 14px; padding: 14px 16px;
            border-radius: 12px; background: var(--card-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
            flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; flex-shrink: 0;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow); animation: slideDown 0.2s ease-out;
        }
        @keyframes slideDown {
            from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-8px); }
            to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
        }
        .incoming-header {
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
            font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: var(--accent);
            letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .incoming-body {
            font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.45; max-height: 120px; overflow-y: auto;
            word-break: break-word; user-select: text !important; -webkit-user-select: text !important;
            color: var(--text);
        }
        .incoming-actions { display: flex; gap: 8px; }
        .incoming-btn {
            flex: 1; padding: 10px 14px; font-size: 13px; border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--accent); background: var(--accent);
            color: #fff; font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            text-align: center; transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }
        .incoming-btn:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 12px var(--accent-glow); filter: brightness(1.06); }
        .incoming-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
        .incoming-btn.secondary {
            background: var(--panel); border-color: var(--panel-border); color: var(--text);
        }
        .incoming-btn.success { background: #00c853 !important; border-color: #00c853 !important; }

        main {
            flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
            padding: 12px 14px 4px 14px; gap: 8px; min-height: 0;
        }
        .textarea-wrapper { flex: 1; display: flex; min-height: 0; }

        textarea {
            flex: 1; width: 100%; background: var(--textarea-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--textarea-border); border-radius: 14px;
            color: var(--text); font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.55; padding: 16px;
            outline: none; resize: none; font-family: inherit;
            user-select: text !important; -webkit-user-select: text !important;
            -webkit-appearance: none;
        }
        textarea:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
        textarea::placeholder { color: var(--placeholder); font-size: 16px; }

        .utility-row {
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
            padding: 2px 2px; flex-shrink: 0;
        }
        .tag-counter {
            font-size: 11px; font-family: monospace; color: var(--text-dim);
            background: var(--chip-bg); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px;
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); font-weight: 600;
        }
        .chip-bar { display: flex; gap: 6px; }
        .chip {
            background: var(--chip-bg); border: 1px solid var(--chip-border);
            color: var(--text); font-size: 11px; font-family: monospace;
            padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
            font-weight: 700; transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }
        .chip:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
            border-color: var(--accent); background: var(--chip-hover-bg);
        }
        .chip:active { transform: scale(0.96); background: var(--accent); color: #fff; }

        footer { display: flex; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 14px 14px 14px; flex-shrink: 0; }
        button {
            border: none; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 800;
            cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit;
        }
        .btn-clear {
            background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 13px; padding: 0 18px; height: 56px; min-width: 70px;
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }
        .btn-clear:hover {
            background: var(--clear-hover-bg);
            border-color: var(--clear-hover-border);
            color: var(--clear-hover-text);
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
        }
        .btn-clear:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

        #send-btn {
            flex: 1; height: 56px; background: var(--accent); color: #fff;
            font-size: 17px; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 14px var(--accent-glow);
            transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }
        #send-btn:hover {
            background: var(--accent-hover);
            box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent-glow);
            filter: brightness(1.06);
        }
        #send-btn:active { transform: scale(0.98); }
        #send-btn.success { background: #00c853 !important; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 200, 83, 0.5) !important; }

        /* Unified History Drawer */
        #history-sheet {
            position: absolute; top: 61px; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
            background: var(--history-bg); backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
            display: none; flex-direction: column; z-index: 110; padding: 18px;
            animation: fadeIn 0.15s ease-out;
        }
        @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
        #history-sheet.open { display: flex; }

        .drawer-sub-header {
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 12px;
        }
        .drawer-title {
            font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1px; font-size: 13px;
            color: var(--text-dim); text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .drawer-top-action {
            background: var(--chip-bg); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            color: var(--accent); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; padding: 6px 12px;
            border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }
        .drawer-top-action:hover {
            border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent-glow);
        }

        .history-list {
            flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;
            padding-bottom: 25px;
        }

        /* Swipeable Card Wrapper: flex-shrink 0 locks natural card height */
        .history-item-wrapper {
            flex-shrink: 0 !important;
            position: relative; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 12px;
            background: #0f172a;
            transition: max-height 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1),
                        opacity 0.2s ease,
                        margin-bottom 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
        }
        .swipe-underlay {
            position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
            padding: 0 20px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        .underlay-left { color: #0099ff; }
        .underlay-right { color: #ef4444; }

        /* Card Container */
        .history-item {
            flex-shrink: 0 !important;
            background: var(--history-item-bg); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow); position: relative; z-index: 2; cursor: pointer;
            transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
        }
        .history-item:hover { border-color: var(--accent); }
        .history-meta {
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
            font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent);
        }
        .history-meta-right {
            font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-dim); font-family: monospace;
        }
        .history-text {
            font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text);
            user-select: text !important; -webkit-user-select: text !important;
            word-break: break-word;
        }

        /* Buttons on Cards */
        .history-actions {
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; width: 100%;
            margin-top: 2px;
        }
        .history-left-group {
            display: flex; gap: 6px; align-items: center;
        }
        .card-btn {
            background: var(--chip-bg); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            color: var(--text); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; padding: 6px 14px;
            border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease;
        }
        .card-btn.copy {
            background: var(--accent); color: #fff; border-color: var(--accent);
            font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .card-btn.copy:hover { box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-glow); filter: brightness(1.1); }
        .card-btn.copy.success { background: #00c853 !important; border-color: #00c853 !important; }
        .card-btn.delete { color: var(--text-dim); }
        .card-btn.delete:hover {
            background: var(--clear-hover-bg); border-color: var(--clear-hover-border);
            color: var(--clear-hover-text); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25);
        }
        .card-btn.archive-desktop {
            color: var(--text-dim); display: none;
        }
        .card-btn.archive-desktop:hover {
            border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent);
        }

        /* Desktop Hover: Show archive button next to delete; actions can subtly brighten */
        @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
            .card-btn.archive-desktop { display: inline-block; }
            .history-actions {
                opacity: 0.65; transition: opacity 0.15s ease;
            }
            .history-item:hover .history-actions { opacity: 1; }
        }

        /* Bottom Controls Row: Perfectly Symmetrical */
        .drawer-bottom-bar {
            margin-top: 10px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
            padding-bottom: 25px; flex-shrink: 0; gap: 10px;
        }
        .btn-bottom-action {
            background: var(--chip-bg); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            color: var(--text); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; padding: 10px 18px;
            border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: 0.5px; transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }
        .btn-bottom-action.danger {
            background: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.08); border-color: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.25); color: #ef4444;
        }
        .btn-bottom-action.danger:hover {
            background: rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.18); border-color: #ef4444; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(220, 38, 38, 0.3);
        }
        .btn-bottom-action.secondary:hover {
            border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent-glow);
        }
        .btn-bottom-action:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

        /* Toast Snackbar */
        #toast {
            position: fixed; bottom: 20px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(100px);
            background: var(--panel); border: 1px solid var(--panel-border); color: var(--text);
            padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 10px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700;
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            z-index: 200; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
        }
        #toast.show { transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0); }
        .toast-undo {
            color: var(--accent); background: none; border: none; font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 800; cursor: pointer; text-transform: uppercase;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div id="app-root">
        <header>
            <div class="brand">
                <div class="status-dot"></div>
                VoiceBridge
                <span class="version-tag">v1.0</span>
            </div>
            <div class="header-actions">
                <button class="icon-btn" title="Reload" onclick="window.location.reload()">&#x21bb;</button>
                <button class="btn-header" id="history-toggle-btn" onclick="toggleHistoryDrawer()">HISTORY</button>
            </div>
        </header>

        <!-- Incoming from Mac (on phone) -->
        <div id="incoming-card">
            <div class="incoming-header">
                <span>Received from Mac</span>
                <span style="font-size:18px; cursor:pointer; padding:2px 8px;" onclick="closeIncoming()">&#x2715;</span>
            </div>
            <div class="incoming-body" id="incoming-text"></div>
            <div class="incoming-actions">
                <button class="incoming-btn" id="copy-btn" onclick="copyIncoming()">COPY TO CLIPBOARD</button>
                <button class="incoming-btn secondary" onclick="insertIncoming()">INSERT TO BOX</button>
            </div>
        </div>

        <main>
            <div class="textarea-wrapper">
                <textarea id="input"></textarea>
            </div>

            <div class="utility-row">
                <div class="tag-counter" id="counter">0w &bull; 0c</div>
                <div class="chip-bar">
                    <button class="chip" onclick="insertText('&bull; ')">+ Bullet</button>
                </div>
            </div>
        </main>

        <footer>
            <button class="btn-clear" onclick="clearText()">CLEAR</button>
            <button id="send-btn" onpointerdown="handlePointerDown(event)" onclick="handleSend()">SEND TO MAC</button>
        </footer>

        <!-- Unified Dynamic History & Archive Drawer -->
        <div id="history-sheet">
            <div class="drawer-sub-header">
                <div class="drawer-title" id="drawer-view-title">CLIPBOARD HISTORY</div>
                <button class="drawer-top-action" id="drawer-top-action" style="display:none;" onclick="exportArchive()">EXPORT (.TXT)</button>
            </div>
            <div class="history-list" id="drawer-items"></div>
            <div class="drawer-bottom-bar" id="drawer-bottom-bar"></div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <div id="toast">
        <span id="toast-text">Action completed</span>
        <button class="toast-undo" id="toast-undo-btn" onclick="undoAction()">UNDO</button>
    </div>

    <script>
        const input = document.getElementById('input');
        const counter = document.getElementById('counter');
        const sendBtn = document.getElementById('send-btn');
        const incomingCard = document.getElementById('incoming-card');
        const incomingText = document.getElementById('incoming-text');
        const copyBtn = document.getElementById('copy-btn');
        const historySheet = document.getElementById('history-sheet');
        const drawerItems = document.getElementById('drawer-items');
        const drawerBottomBar = document.getElementById('drawer-bottom-bar');
        const drawerTitle = document.getElementById('drawer-view-title');
        const drawerTopAction = document.getElementById('drawer-top-action');
        const historyToggleBtn = document.getElementById('history-toggle-btn');
        const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
        const toastText = document.getElementById('toast-text');

        let lastSeenId = 0;
        let activeHistory = [];
        let archivedHistory = [];
        let currentDrawerView = 'history';
        let isDrawerOpen = false;

        let lastActionBuffer = null;
        let toastTimeout = null;

        const isMac = !/Android|iPhone|iPad|Mobile/i.test(navigator.userAgent);

        if (isMac) {
            sendBtn.innerText = "SEND TO PHONE";
            input.placeholder = "Type or paste on Mac to push over to your phone...";
        } else {
            sendBtn.innerText = "SEND TO MAC";
            input.placeholder = "Tap mic on Gboard to dictate...";
        }

        function handlePointerDown(e) {
            if (!isMac) {
                e.preventDefault();
            }
        }

        // Automatic Light/Dark Theme Detection
        const themeQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');
        function applyThemeMeta(e) {
            const meta = document.getElementById('meta-theme-color');
            if (meta) meta.setAttribute('content', e.matches ? '#070a0e' : '#f8fafc');
        }
        themeQuery.addEventListener('change', applyThemeMeta);
        applyThemeMeta(themeQuery);

        // Universal Copy Helper
        function copyToClipboard(text) {
            if (navigator.clipboard && navigator.clipboard.writeText) {
                return navigator.clipboard.writeText(text).catch(() => fallbackCopy(text));
            }
            return fallbackCopy(text);
        }

        function fallbackCopy(text) {
            const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
            ta.value = text;
            ta.style.position = "fixed";
            ta.style.left = "-9999px";
            ta.style.top = "0";
            document.body.appendChild(ta);
            ta.focus();
            ta.select();
            try {
                document.execCommand('copy');
                return Promise.resolve();
            } catch (e) {
                return Promise.reject(e);
            } finally {
                document.body.removeChild(ta);
            }
        }

        // WebAudio Sound Synthesis
        const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
        function playChime(freq = 600, duration = 0.08) {
            try {
                if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
                const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                osc.type = 'sine';
                osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
                osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq * 1.5, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.12, audioCtx.currentTime);
                gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                osc.start();
                osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        input.addEventListener('input', updateCount);

        function updateCount() {
            const val = input.value.trim();
            const chars = input.value.length;
            const words = val ? val.split(/\\s+/).length : 0;
            counter.innerHTML = `${words}w &bull; ${chars}c`;
        }

        function clearText() {
            input.value = '';
            updateCount();
            input.focus();
        }

        function insertText(str) {
            const start = input.selectionStart;
            const end = input.selectionEnd;
            input.value = input.value.substring(0, start) + str + input.value.substring(end);
            input.selectionStart = input.selectionEnd = start + str.length;
            updateCount();
        }

        function handleSend() {
            const text = input.value;
            if (!text.trim()) return;

            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(30);
            playChime(isMac ? 680 : 540);

            sendBtn.classList.add('success');
            const originalText = sendBtn.innerText;

            if (isMac) {
                // Mac pushes to Phone (text remains in box)
                sendBtn.innerText = 'SENT TO PHONE!';
                fetch('/send-to-phone', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ text: text })
                }).then(() => {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        sendBtn.classList.remove('success');
                        sendBtn.innerText = originalText;
                    }, 1000);
                });
            } else {
                // Phone dictates to Mac cursor
                sendBtn.innerText = 'SENT!';
                fetch('/paste', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ text: text })
                }).then(() => {
                    input.value = '';
                    updateCount();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        sendBtn.classList.remove('success');
                        sendBtn.innerText = originalText;
                    }, 400);
                }).catch(() => {
                    sendBtn.classList.remove('success');
                    sendBtn.innerText = 'FAILED TO REACH MAC';
                    setTimeout(() => { sendBtn.innerText = originalText; }, 1500);
                });
            }
        }

        function pollSync() {
            fetch('/poll')
                .then(r => r.json())
                .then(data => {
                    if (!data) return;
                    if (!isMac) {
                        const msg = data.phone_msg;
                        if (msg && msg.id > lastSeenId && msg.text) {
                            lastSeenId = msg.id;
                            showIncoming(msg.text);
                        }
                    }
                })
                .catch(() => {})
                .finally(() => {
                    setTimeout(pollSync, 1000);
                });
        }
        pollSync();

        function showIncoming(txt) {
            incomingText.innerText = txt;
            incomingCard.style.display = 'flex';
            copyBtn.innerText = 'COPY TO CLIPBOARD';
            copyBtn.classList.remove('success');
            playChime(720, 0.12);
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate([30, 40, 30]);
        }

        function closeIncoming() {
            incomingCard.style.display = 'none';
        }

        function copyIncoming() {
            copyToClipboard(incomingText.innerText).then(() => {
                copyBtn.innerText = 'COPIED!';
                copyBtn.classList.add('success');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    copyBtn.innerText = 'COPY TO CLIPBOARD';
                    copyBtn.classList.remove('success');
                }, 900);
            });
        }

        function insertIncoming() {
            insertText(incomingText.innerText);
            closeIncoming();
        }

        // Unified Drawer Toggle
        function toggleHistoryDrawer() {
            isDrawerOpen = !isDrawerOpen;
            if (isDrawerOpen) {
                historyToggleBtn.innerText = 'CLOSE';
                historyToggleBtn.classList.add('active-close');
                loadDrawerData(() => {
                    renderDrawerView();
                    historySheet.classList.add('open');
                });
            } else {
                historyToggleBtn.innerText = 'HISTORY';
                historyToggleBtn.classList.remove('active-close');
                historySheet.classList.remove('open');
            }
        }

        function switchDrawerView(view) {
            currentDrawerView = view;
            renderDrawerView();
        }

        function loadDrawerData(callback) {
            fetch('/history')
                .then(r => r.json())
                .then(data => {
                    activeHistory = data.history || [];
                    archivedHistory = data.archive || [];
                    if (callback) callback();
                });
        }

        function renderDrawerView() {
            const isArchive = currentDrawerView === 'archive';
            drawerTitle.innerText = isArchive ? 'ARCHIVED MESSAGES' : 'CLIPBOARD HISTORY';
            drawerTopAction.style.display = isArchive ? 'block' : 'none';

            const items = isArchive ? archivedHistory : activeHistory;

            if (items.length === 0) {
                drawerItems.innerHTML = `<div style="color:var(--text-dim); text-align:center; margin-top:40px; font-size:13px;">${isArchive ? 'No archived messages.' : 'No active history yet.'}</div>`;
            } else {
                drawerItems.innerHTML = items.map((item, idx) => {
                    const words = item.text.trim() ? item.text.trim().split(/\\s+/).length : 0;
                    const chars = item.text.length;
                    const touchProps = !isMac ? `
                        ontouchstart="handleTouchStart(event, ${item.id})"
                        ontouchmove="handleTouchMove(event, ${item.id})"
                        ontouchend="handleTouchEnd(event, ${item.id})"
                    ` : '';

                    return `
                        <div class="history-item-wrapper" id="history-wrapper-${item.id}">
                            <div class="swipe-underlay">
                                <span class="underlay-left">&rarr; ARCHIVE</span>
                                <span class="underlay-right">DELETE &larr;</span>
                            </div>
                            <div class="history-item" id="history-card-${item.id}"
                                 data-id="${item.id}"
                                 data-index="${idx}"
                                 ${touchProps}>
                                <div class="history-meta">
                                    <span>FROM ${item.from.toUpperCase()} &bull; ${words}w ${chars}c</span>
                                    <span class="history-meta-right">${item.time}</span>
                                </div>
                                <div class="history-text" onclick="handleCardClick(${idx})">${escapeHtml(item.text)}</div>
                                
                                <div class="history-actions">
                                    <div class="history-left-group">
                                        <button class="card-btn delete" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); triggerDismissAnimation(${item.id}, 'delete')">DELETE</button>
                                        ${(!isArchive && isMac) ? `<button class="card-btn archive-desktop" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); triggerDismissAnimation(${item.id}, 'archive')">ARCHIVE</button>` : ''}
                                    </div>
                                    <button class="card-btn copy" onclick="event.stopPropagation(); copyHistoryText('${escapeJsString(item.text)}', this)">COPY</button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }).join('');
            }

            // Symmetrical Bottom Navigation
            if (isArchive) {
                drawerBottomBar.innerHTML = `
                    <button class="btn-bottom-action danger" onclick="clearScope('archive')">CLEAR ARCHIVE</button>
                    <button class="btn-bottom-action secondary" onclick="switchDrawerView('history')">&larr; BACK</button>
                `;
            } else {
                drawerBottomBar.innerHTML = `
                    <button class="btn-bottom-action danger" onclick="clearScope('history')">CLEAR ALL HISTORY</button>
                    <button class="btn-bottom-action secondary" onclick="switchDrawerView('archive')">ARCHIVE (${archivedHistory.length}) &rarr;</button>
                `;
            }
        }

        function handleCardClick(idx) {
            const list = currentDrawerView === 'archive' ? archivedHistory : activeHistory;
            if (list[idx]) {
                const text = list[idx].text;
                input.value = text;
                updateCount();
                copyToClipboard(text);
                toggleHistoryDrawer();
                input.focus();
                showToast("Loaded to box & copied!");
            }
        }

        function copyHistoryText(text, btn) {
            copyToClipboard(text).then(() => {
                btn.innerText = 'COPIED!';
                btn.classList.add('success');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    btn.innerText = 'COPY';
                    btn.classList.remove('success');
                }, 800);
            });
        }

        // Smooth Accordion Card Dismissal (Zero Snapping)
        function triggerDismissAnimation(id, action) {
            const card = document.getElementById(`history-card-${id}`);
            const wrapper = document.getElementById(`history-wrapper-${id}`);
            if (!card || !wrapper) return;

            // Step 1: Slide card horizontally off-screen
            card.style.transition = 'transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1, 0.3, 1)';
            card.style.transform = action === 'delete' ? 'translateX(-105%)' : 'translateX(105%)';

            // Step 2: Smoothly collapse vertical height
            setTimeout(() => {
                const currentHeight = wrapper.offsetHeight;
                wrapper.style.maxHeight = currentHeight + 'px';
                
                requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                    wrapper.style.maxHeight = '0px';
                    wrapper.style.opacity = '0';
                    wrapper.style.marginBottom = '-12px';
                    wrapper.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
                });

                // Step 3: Mutate data and re-render only after transition completes
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (action === 'delete') {
                        deleteItem(id);
                    } else if (action === 'archive') {
                        archiveItem(id);
                    }
                }, 240);
            }, 200);
        }

        // Mobile Two-Way Swipe Physics
        let touchStartX = 0;
        let touchStartY = 0;
        let activeSwipeId = null;

        function handleTouchStart(e, id) {
            touchStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
            touchStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
            activeSwipeId = id;
            const card = document.getElementById(`history-card-${id}`);
            if (card) card.style.transition = 'none';
        }

        function handleTouchMove(e, id) {
            if (activeSwipeId !== id) return;
            const diffX = e.touches[0].clientX - touchStartX;
            const diffY = e.touches[0].clientY - touchStartY;
            if (Math.abs(diffX) > Math.abs(diffY)) {
                const card = document.getElementById(`history-card-${id}`);
                if (card) {
                    card.style.transform = `translateX(${diffX}px)`;
                }
            }
        }

        function handleTouchEnd(e, id) {
            if (activeSwipeId !== id) return;
            activeSwipeId = null;
            const card = document.getElementById(`history-card-${id}`);
            if (!card) return;

            const matrix = new WebKitCSSMatrix(window.getComputedStyle(card).transform);
            const deltaX = matrix.m41;

            if (deltaX < -70) {
                // Swipe Left: Delete with accordion collapse
                triggerDismissAnimation(id, 'delete');
            } else if (deltaX > 70 && currentDrawerView === 'history') {
                // Swipe Right: Archive with accordion collapse
                triggerDismissAnimation(id, 'archive');
            } else {
                // Smooth snap back
                card.style.transition = 'transform 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.2, 1, 0.3, 1)';
                card.style.transform = 'translateX(0)';
            }
        }

        function archiveItem(id) {
            const index = activeHistory.findIndex(it => it.id === id);
            if (index === -1) return;

            const item = activeHistory[index];
            activeHistory.splice(index, 1);
            archivedHistory.unshift(item);
            renderDrawerView();

            fetch('/history/archive', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({ id: id })
            });

            lastActionBuffer = { action: 'archive', item: item, index: index };
            showToast("Item moved to archive");
        }

        function deleteItem(id) {
            const isArchive = currentDrawerView === 'archive';
            const list = isArchive ? archivedHistory : activeHistory;
            const index = list.findIndex(it => it.id === id);
            if (index === -1) return;

            const item = list[index];
            list.splice(index, 1);
            renderDrawerView();

            fetch('/history/delete', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({ id: id, from_archive: isArchive })
            });

            lastActionBuffer = { action: 'delete', item: item, index: index, wasArchive: isArchive };
            showToast("Item deleted");
        }

        function undoAction() {
            if (!lastActionBuffer) return;
            const buf = lastActionBuffer;

            if (buf.action === 'delete') {
                const list = buf.wasArchive ? archivedHistory : activeHistory;
                list.splice(buf.index, 0, buf.item);
                renderDrawerView();
                fetch('/history/restore', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ item: buf.item, target: buf.wasArchive ? 'archive' : 'history' })
                });
            } else if (buf.action === 'archive') {
                archivedHistory = archivedHistory.filter(it => it.id !== buf.item.id);
                activeHistory.splice(buf.index, 0, buf.item);
                renderDrawerView();
                fetch('/history/restore', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                    body: JSON.stringify({ item: buf.item, target: 'history', remove_from_archive: true })
                });
            }

            hideToast();
            if (navigator.vibrate) navigator.vibrate(25);
        }

        function showToast(text) {
            toastText.innerText = text;
            toast.classList.add('show');
            if (toastTimeout) clearTimeout(toastTimeout);
            toastTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
                hideToast();
            }, 4000);
        }

        function hideToast() {
            toast.classList.remove('show');
            lastActionBuffer = null;
        }

        function clearScope(scope) {
            fetch('/history/clear', {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                body: JSON.stringify({ target: scope })
            }).then(() => {
                if (scope === 'archive') archivedHistory = [];
                else activeHistory = [];
                renderDrawerView();
            });
        }

        function exportArchive() {
            if (archivedHistory.length === 0) return;
            const formatted = archivedHistory.map(it => `[${it.time}] FROM ${it.from.toUpperCase()}:\\n${it.text}\\n`).join('\\n---\\n\\n');
            const blob = new Blob([formatted], { type: 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = `voicebridge-archive-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.txt`;
            document.body.appendChild(a);
            a.click();
            document.body.removeChild(a);
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
        }

        function escapeHtml(str) {
            return str.replace(/&/g, "&amp;").replace(/</g, "&lt;").replace(/>/g, "&gt;").replace(/"/g, "&quot;").replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
        }

        function escapeJsString(str) {
            return str.replace(/\\\\/g, '\\\\\\\\').replace(/'/g, "\\\\'").replace(/"/g, '\\\\"')
                      .replace(/\\n/g, '\\\\n').replace(/\\r/g, '\\\\r');
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>
"""

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def send_no_cache_headers(self, content_type='text/html; charset=utf-8', status=200):
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header('Content-type', content_type)
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate')
        self.send_header('Pragma', 'no-cache')
        self.send_header('Expires', '0')
        self.send_header('Connection', 'close')
        self.end_headers()

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path.startswith('/poll'):
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json')
            data = {
                "phone_msg": SERVER_STATE["phone_msg"],
                "mac_msg": SERVER_STATE["mac_msg"]
            }
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps(data).encode('utf-8'))

        elif self.path == '/history':
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json')
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({
                "history": SERVER_STATE["history"],
                "archive": SERVER_STATE["archive"]
            }).encode('utf-8'))

        else:
            self.send_no_cache_headers('text/html; charset=utf-8')
            self.wfile.write(HTML.encode('utf-8'))

    def do_POST(self):
        length = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length', 0))
        body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode('utf-8')) if length > 0 else {}

        if self.path == '/paste':
            text = body.get('text', '')
            if text:
                p = subprocess.Popen(['pbcopy'], stdin=subprocess.PIPE)
                p.communicate(text.encode('utf-8'))

                subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "v" using command down'])

                cur_id = int(time.time() * 1000)
                now_str = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                SERVER_STATE["mac_msg"] = {"id": cur_id, "text": text, "time": now_str}
                SERVER_STATE["history"].insert(0, {"id": cur_id, "text": text, "from": "phone", "time": now_str})
                save_data(SERVER_STATE)

            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(b'{"status":"ok"}')

        elif self.path == '/send-to-phone':
            text = body.get('text', '')
            if text:
                cur_id = int(time.time() * 1000)
                now_str = time.strftime("%H:%M:%S")
                SERVER_STATE["phone_msg"] = {"id": cur_id, "text": text, "time": now_str}
                SERVER_STATE["history"].insert(0, {"id": cur_id, "text": text, "from": "mac", "time": now_str})
                save_data(SERVER_STATE)

            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(json.dumps({"status": "ok", "id": cur_id}).encode('utf-8'))

        elif self.path == '/history/archive':
            msg_id = body.get('id')
            item = next((it for it in SERVER_STATE["history"] if it.get("id") == msg_id), None)
            if item:
                SERVER_STATE["history"] = [it for it in SERVER_STATE["history"] if it.get("id") != msg_id]
                SERVER_STATE["archive"].insert(0, item)
                save_data(SERVER_STATE)
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(b'{"status":"ok"}')

        elif self.path == '/history/delete':
            msg_id = body.get('id')
            from_archive = body.get('from_archive', False)
            target = "archive" if from_archive else "history"
            SERVER_STATE[target] = [it for it in SERVER_STATE[target] if it.get("id") != msg_id]
            save_data(SERVER_STATE)
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(b'{"status":"ok"}')

        elif self.path == '/history/restore':
            item = body.get('item')
            target = body.get('target', 'history')
            remove_archive = body.get('remove_from_archive', False)
            if item:
                if remove_archive:
                    SERVER_STATE["archive"] = [it for it in SERVER_STATE["archive"] if it.get("id") != item.get("id")]
                SERVER_STATE[target].insert(0, item)
                save_data(SERVER_STATE)
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(b'{"status":"ok"}')

        elif self.path == '/history/clear':
            target = body.get('target', 'history')
            SERVER_STATE[target] = []
            save_data(SERVER_STATE)
            self.send_no_cache_headers('application/json', 200)
            self.wfile.write(b'{"status":"ok"}')

    def log_message(self, format, *args):
        return

if __name__ == '__main__':
    port = 5050
    s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM)
    try:
        s.connect(('8.8.8.8', 80))
        local_ip = s.getsockname()[0]
    except Exception:
        local_ip = 'localhost'
    finally:
        s.close()

    print(f"VoiceBridge v1.0 running at: http://{local_ip}:{port}")
    ThreadingHTTPServer(('0.0.0.0', port), Handler).serve_forever()
```

1. **Grounded Bottom Dock (No More Floating Gap)**:The bottom action bar (CLEAR ALL HISTORY / ARCHIVE →) is now a docked footer bar with a subtle top border that sits flush against the bottom of the screen. No empty black gap underneath.**Sleek Custom Scrollbar**:Replaced the chunky default browser scrollbar with a subtle 5px semi-transparent bar that matches your theme and highlights with an accent glow on hover.**Fluid Swipe Physics & Simultaneous Slide-Up (No Snapping)**:On mobile, horizontal drags now prevent browser scroll conflicts (preventDefault on horizontal intent), so the touch stream never lags or freezes mid-swipe.When swiped past the threshold, the card flies away **while the list below simultaneously glides up** in one continuous, natural motion (no 200ms delay, no sudden snapping).If released before the threshold, it snaps back with a soft rubber-band spring ease instead of a stiff stop.**Auto-Reset on Close**:Closing the drawer (via CLOSE or clicking outside) now automatically resets the view back to the **default history view**, so opening it again will never strand you in the Archive view.**Shortened Toast**:Changed the clunky two-line message to a clean, single-line toast: **Loaded & Copied** with white-space: nowrap so it never wraps or clips on mobile.

import os
import subprocess
import socket
import json
import time
from http.server import ThreadingHTTPServer, BaseHTTPRequestHandler

HISTORY_FILE = os.path.expanduser("~/.voicebridge/history.json")

def load_data():
    default_data = {"history": [], "archive": []}
    try:
        if os.path.exists(HISTORY_FILE):
            with open(HISTORY_FILE, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                d = json.load(f)
                if isinstance(d, list):
                    return {"history": d, "archive": []}
                return d
    except Exception:
        pass
    return default_data

def save_data(data):
    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(HISTORY_FILE), exist_ok=True)
        with open(HISTORY_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump({
                "history": data.get("history", [])[:60],
                "archive": data.get("archive", [])[:100]
            }, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    except Exception:
        pass

DATA_STORE = load_data()

SERVER_STATE = {
    "phone_msg": {"id": 0, "text": "", "time": ""},
    "mac_msg": {"id": 0, "text": "", "time": ""},
    "history": DATA_STORE.get("history", []),
    "archive": DATA_STORE.get("archive", [])
}
